jobs.title: Market Research Project Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Overview: 
 The Market Research Team conducts custom survey projects for institutional investment firms, consultancy firms, and corporate organizations. Our team is focused on facilitating custom primary research survey projects for clients who wish to understand market trends within the Healthcare, TMT (Technology, Media & Telecom), Consumer Goods, and Energy & Industrials markets. 
 This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office.  
 What You’ll Do: 
 Work alongside Market Research Project Managers and manage online surveys throughout the entire project life cycle. Tasks include:  
 Edit survey questionnaires to fit respondent-friendly formats and programming formats in Qualtrics 
 Research, identify, and recruit appropriate respondents needed to meet quotas for survey recruiting 
 Program and test questionnaires for online surveys 
 Manage relationships with survey respondents and vendors, and answer all technical and non-technical questions about the survey 
 Respond to RFQs and assess pricing and feasibility 
 Conversion of large quantities of data from surveys into client-deliverable formats using Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint 
 Ensure clients are regularly updated on survey status and their needs are continually met 
 Work on ad-hoc project requests 
 Work with other teams across Guidepoint in assisting and implementing surveys 
 What You Have: 
 Completed bachelor's degree in related field 
 1-3+ years of market research or related experience 
 Strong Qualtrics experience required – ability to create and troubleshoot complex surveys 
 Excellent communication skills; both written and verbal 
 Proficient in use of the internet for completion of timely research projects 
 Demonstrated ability to work in a team atmosphere with minimal supervision 
 A desire to work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment 
 What We Offer: 
 The annual base salary for this position is $70,000 - $74,000. Additionally, this position is eligible for a yearly bonus based on performance. 
 You will also be eligible for the following benefits: 
 15 PTO Days, 10 legal holidays, and sick days 
 Comprehensive Medical, dental, and vision plans 
 Will match up to 10% of employee contribution for 401(k), life insurance, paid time-off and parental leave plans 
 Commuter benefits and a corporate discounts 
 Development opportunities through the LinkedIn Learning platform 
 Friday happy hour, “Summer Fridays”, and free snacks and beverages in the office 
 Year-round corporate athletic league 
 Casual work environment, team building, and other social events 
 About Guidepoint: 
 Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams. 
 Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process—from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions. 
 At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed. 
 #LI-KD1
 #LI-HYBRID
 Base salary may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as geographic location.
 Compensation
 $70,000 — $74,000 USD

Accountabilities
 Construction Execution and Delivery: Oversee day-to-day construction of 500kV substations and transmission line facilities, including site civil works, pad foundations, steel erection, high-voltage electrical equipment installation, integration of owner-furnished equipment, and balance-of-plant (BOP) activities through Mechanical Completion, energization, and COD.
 EPC and OEM Contract Management: Manage Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contractors and high-voltage equipment manufacturers (OEMs), ensuring compliance with contractual scope, milestones, technical submittals, equipment delivery schedules, and change order requirements.
 Integration and Commissioning: Coordinate with Commissioning, Electrical, and Engineering teams to support initial energization, capacity and efficiency testing, grid integration, and readiness for commercial market participation.
 Interconnection and SCADA Coordination: Work with Transmission Owners, ISO/RTO organizations, and internal engineering teams to coordinate interconnection facility upgrades, SCADA and telemetry integration, and associated testing schedules.
 Budget and Schedule Management: Monitor project budgets, cost forecasts, cash flows, and critical-path schedules. Identify delivery risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect project milestones and financial objectives.
 Operational Handover: Coordinate the transfer of completed substations and transmission line facilities to Operations and Maintenance (O&M) and Asset Management teams, including as-built documentation, warranties, and technical records.
 Safety and Regulatory Compliance: Maintain rigorous site safety oversight, enforce project-specific safety plans, and ensure compliance with applicable codes and local environmental permitting requirements.
 Cross-Functional Project Leadership: Serve as the central point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Engineering, Procurement, Origination, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
 Technical and Executive Coordination: Work with Owner’s Engineers to confirm engineering deliverables meet project specifications; review RFIs, technical submittals, and Issued for Construction (IFC) packages; mentor associate project managers; and provide concise progress updates to executive leadership.
 Requirements
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.
 Experience: At least 5 years of construction management or project management experience in utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) or major industrial power projects.
 Project Delivery Track Record: Demonstrated experience serving as Lead Project Manager or Owner’s Representative on at least two utility-scale high-voltage construction projects, managing delivery from NTP through energization and substantial completion or COD.
 High-Voltage Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of 500kV substation and transmission line architecture, as well as applicable CBC, NERC, WECC, CAISO, CPUC, and IEEE requirements.
 Commercial and Grid Knowledge: Solid understanding of EPC contracts, grid interconnection processes, and BESS degradation and guarantee structures.
 Project Management Tools: Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Bluebeam, and project scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project.
 Communication and Reporting: Ability to translate complex construction, schedule, cost, and technical information into clear reports and updates for executive stakeholders.
 Leadership and Stakeholder Management: Strong leadership, negotiation, coordination, and relationship management skills, with the ability to work effectively across contractors, technical teams, and internal business functions.
 Personal Attributes: High attention to detail, proactive risk management, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple large-scale infrastructure projects in a fast-paced environment.
 Benefits
 Compensation: $150,000–$156,250 in total compensation, comprising base salary and bonus.
 Healthcare: 100% premium coverage for employees and dependents on medical, dental, and vision plans.
 Time Off: Unlimited paid time off, plus company-wide breaks around the Fourth of July and at year-end.
 Parental Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, with an additional 6 weeks for birth parents.
 Family Planning: Access to family planning support through Maven.
 Mental Health and Well-being: Spring Health access, including five free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through Wellhub+.
 Retirement: 3% non-elective employer contribution to a 401(k) or RRSP.
 Food and Connectivity: $150 monthly food stipend and $150 monthly cell phone and internet reimbursement.
 Home Office: Full home office setup.
 Additional Perks: Pet insurance allowance, free UrbanSitter access with $625 in quarterly paid company credits, Wellhub+, Perkspot, and One Medical.
 Career Development: Opportunities to contribute to major renewable energy projects, grow professionally, and collaborate across construction, engineering, and operations teams.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
About the company
Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.
About the role
We’re looking for a proactive Business Operations Associate to keep the team running smoothly. You’ll manage vendors, contracts, payments and tool access, help test our product, and improve how we work.
What you’ll do
 - Vendors and contracts: own the vendor inventory (contracts, pricing, owners), track renewals, route NDAs and agreements for signature, and flag unused subscriptions so we can cut costs
 - Payments and finance: process vendor payments, collect invoices and reimbursements, follow up on refunds, and support reconciliation
 - Access management: map our tools, owners and admins, centralize billing, and support access reviews
 - Product support: test new features, report and re-test bugs, triage user feedback, and research vendors and competitors
 - Process and documentation: keep Notion and Google Drive organized, maintain SOPs, automate repetitive tasks, and run meeting logistics
 - Events and travel: plan team offsites and organize travel for trips and industry events
What we’re looking for
 - 3 years in business operations, procurement or finance operations, ideally at a startup or tech company
 - Experience with vendor management, invoices and payments
 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, with strong follow-through
 - Comfortable administering SaaS tools (Google Workspace, Notion, Slack)
Nice to have: a Web3 or fintech background, experience with automation tools (Zapier, Apps Script), AI tools or event-planning experience.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.
WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET?
 - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.
 - Excellent learning and career development opportunities.
 - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.
 - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.
 - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.
 - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.
 - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.
Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.
Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Operations
jobs.description:
About The Company
Reservoir is an independent music company based in New York City and with offices in Los Angeles, Nashville, Toronto, London, Abu Dhabi, and Mumbai. Reservoir is the first female-founded and led publicly traded independent music company in the U.S. Founded as a family-owned music publisher in 2007, Reservoir has grown to represent over 150,000 copyrights and 36,000 master recordings with titles dating as far back as 1900 and hundreds of #1 releases worldwide. Reservoir frequently holds a Top 10 U.S. Market Share according to Billboard’s Publishers Quarterly, was twice named Publisher of the Year by Music Business Worldwide’s The A&R Awards and won Independent Publisher of the Year at the 2020 and 2022 Music Week Awards.
Reservoir also represents a multitude of recorded music through Chrysalis Records, Tommy Boy Records, and Philly Groove Records and manages artists through its ventures with Blue Raincoat Music and Big Life Management.
The Position
The Coordinator, Operations supports the day-to-day operations of Reservoir’s New York office while providing executive support to the CEO, COO, and CFO and assisting the Chief of Staff with research, strategic initiatives, and special projects. This hands-on, entry-level position offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to various aspects of the music business, contribute to company-wide initiatives, and build a strong foundation for career growth within the industry.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful and proactive, with sound judgment and a genuine interest in music. This is an in-office role in New York, reporting to the Chief of Staff. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 - Running day-to-day operations of the New York office, making sure workspaces, conference rooms, the kitchen and common areas are organized, stocked and ready for the team and guests.
 - Greeting and welcoming visitors, guests, artists and songwriters, and serve as the team's first point of contact for office needs.
 - Managing office purchasing, vendors, inventory, mail, deliveries, catering and office events.
 - Providing executive support to the CEO, COO and CFO, including calendars, scheduling, travel and expense reports.
 - Partnering with IT so the office's facilities and technology work well, including setup for new hires, meeting rooms and visitors.
 - Supporting the Chief of Staff with decks and materials for leadership and the Company.
 - Conducting research on potential business opportunities, market developments and competitive activity.
 - Analyzing music industry data using platforms such as Chartmetric, Luminate and Billboard to track artist performance, streaming trends, audience growth and emerging opportunities, and summarize key insights for the team and leadership.
 - Keeping trackers, documentation and internal updates organized and current.
 - Scouting new artists, songwriters and producers across DSPs, socials, live shows, playlists.
 - Working with team to identify catalog songs with momentum, and help build sample packs and a pitch-ready library.
 - Handling ticket purchases for shows and events for the New York office.
 - Supporting teams in the New York office with ad hoc tasks and requests.
Qualifications
 - Bachelor's degree in Music Business, Music Industry, Music Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience in the music industry.
 - 0–2 years of professional experience, including internships, with prior exposure to the music industry preferred.
 - Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, able to juggle competing priorities and follow through.
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively across all levels of the organization.
 - Eager to learn, takes initiative, and comfortable owning work from start to finish.
 - Discreet with confidential information, with sound judgment and a professional approach.
 - Genuine interest in music; familiarity with DSPs is a plus.
 - Proficient in Microsoft Office, Slack and Zoom.
 - Experience using AI tools to improve productivity, research, and workflows.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Reservoir is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that embracing diversity strengthens our culture, drives innovation, and contributes to our continued success.
If you require assistance or an accommodation in completing any aspect of the application process, please contact the Reservoir Recruiting team at: jobs@reservoir-media.com.

 Location: New York, New York | Hybrid (Tuesdays/Thursdays)
 About the role 
 Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.
 We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Associate, GTM hire to join our team. This role sits at the intersection of sales, operations, and AI. Today, much of what happens in our deals lives in email threads, Slack channels, and call recordings, and only part of it reaches HubSpot through manual rep updates. You will build the company intelligence layer that captures all of it, and the AI agents on top of it that keep our CRM current, surface insights for leadership, and give reps their time back to sell.
 Who will love this job: 
 An AI builder – you reach for Claude, GPT, and automation tools first, and you have built workflows, agents, or internal tools that people use every day
 A systems thinker – you see the CRM, inboxes, Slack, and call recordings as one data set and want to connect them
 A data-driven strategist – you use metrics to shape sales process and go-to-market strategy, not only to report on them
 An owner – you find the manual, low-value work that slows reps down and remove it without being asked
 A strong collaborator – you work across sales, marketing, product, and finance, and can explain technical work to a non-technical audience
 What you’ll do: 
 Company Intelligence Layer - Design and build an always-on intelligence ecosystem that captures what happens across email, Slack, and call recordings and connects it to HubSpot, so the full history of every account and deal lives in one place instead of in reps' inboxes and memories
 AI Agents for the Sales Team - Build and maintain agents on top of that data that do work on reps' behalf: monitoring calls, updating projected close dates, deal stages, and product mix in HubSpot, flagging at-risk deals, and drafting follow-ups
 Systems & Data Integrity - Own HubSpot (our CRM) end to end. Move the CRM from rep-entered data to system-maintained data, with clear field definitions, automated hygiene, and an audit trail so leadership can trust what it sees
 Reporting & Forecasting - Partner with sales leadership on pipeline management, quarter-end close, and the forecast that feeds financial planning, executive, and board materials. Build dashboards and reports that give visibility into key sales metrics
 GTM Strategy & Analysis - Analyze performance across the sales process, pricing, product mix, and ideal customer profile, and turn the findings into recommendations for leadership
 Account Management - Manage account distribution so reps keep a healthy pipeline, equitable account assignments, and a balanced mix of core ICP and experimental accounts. Use AI-driven enrichment to fill account data gaps that support qualification
 Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration - Roll out new tools and processes to the sales team with clear guides and training, and work with marketing, finance, product, and implementation to keep systems and processes aligned
 You should have: 
 4-6+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related role (ex. Business Operations, GTM Strategy)
 Hands-on HubSpot experience (required), including workflows, custom properties, integrations, and reporting
 A track record of building with AI: you have shipped workflows, agents, or internal tools using Claude, GPT, or similar models, and can walk us through what you built
 Experience working with unstructured data such as call transcripts, email, and chat, and turning it into structured fields a system can act on
 Strong analytical skills, with experience modeling sales data, reporting, and forecasting
 Comfort with APIs, SQL, and scripting in Python or JavaScript; experience with automation platforms (ex. n8n, Zapier, Make) or agent frameworks is a plus
 Ability to manage multiple projects and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is preferred
 Compensation: $130,000 - $150,000 OTE, dependent on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience, and other qualifications.
 About Setpoint: 
 Setpoint provides purpose-built capital and technology to asset-backed borrowers and lenders. Our platform is the funding operating system for originators: it verifies and stores documents; automates critical calculations and compliance reporting; and digitizes assets like homes or cars. Setpoint’s technology makes warehouse transactions instant and error free.
 In August 2024, Setpoint announced the successful completion of its $31 million Series B funding round. 645 Ventures led the round, with significant strategic investments from Citi and Wells Fargo, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, NextView Ventures, Floating Point, Henry Kravis, Zillow founder’s 75 & Sunny, Vesta Ventures, Fifth Wall, Eltura Ventures, and Outrunner Capital.
 For all our employees, we offer a full slate of benefits from competitive salaries, stock options, medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k, disability coverage, and flexible vacation. Setpoint has offices in Austin, New York, and Park City, UT and we’re currently hiring remote team members for specific roles.
 Setpoint provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. 
 About Setpoint: 
 Setpoint is the new operating standard for asset-backed finance. Our collaborative, AI-native platform brings capital providers and borrowers together around the same verified information: extracting and verifying asset and servicer data, automating reporting and compliance, and surfacing risk and opportunity in real time. Leading institutions use Setpoint to strengthen oversight, reduce risk, and make better decisions across $550B+ in financed assets.

jobs.title: Provider Onboarding Coordinator (Credentialing)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAILOR HEALTH
Sailor Health is revolutionizing mental health care for older adults, addressing one of the fastest-growing and most underserved healthcare segments in America. With over 60 million seniors expected to make up nearly 25% of the population by 2030, we’re entering a period of unprecedented demand for care. Yet, today, millions of older adults remain isolated, underserved, and struggling with mental health challenges such as anxiety, depression, loneliness without adequate support.
At Sailor Health, we envision a world where every senior has seamless access to compassionate, effective, and personalized mental health care. Join us on our mission to redefine the golden years, enabling older adults across the nation to live happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.
⭐ ABOUT THE ROLE
Location: Remote - US
Title: Credentialing Onboarding Specialist
Salary Range: $32,000 USD
We’re hiring a full-time remote Provider Onboarding Coordinator (Credentialing) to support onboarding aspects of provider credentialing at Sailor Health. You will own end-to-end coordination of provider enrollments & systems access, maintain accurate CAQH profiles, establish SOPs, and monitor credentialing timelines. You’ll join as part of the Provider Onboarding team and work cross-functionally with Credentialing and Payer teams to ensure Sailor’s provider network is compliant, current, and optimized for success.
💻 YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
What You’ll Do
 - Manage provider system enrollments: Coordinate with providers to ensure they complete required Medicare enrollment actions, connect to the appropriate profiles and systems, and sign applications and other documents on time.
 - Maintain provider data: Keep CAQH profiles complete, accurate, and up to date, ensuring provider credentials, licenses, and practice information are properly maintained.
 - Support providers: Serve as a primary credentialing point of contact for providers, answering questions, communicating required actions, and following up on outstanding items.
 - Monitor enrollment requirements: Track provider actions, signature requests, correction requests, notices, deadlines, and other outstanding requirements to keep Medicare enrollment moving forward.
 - Collaborate across teams: Partner with internal stakeholders, including Credentialing and RCM Support, to align priorities, communicate progress, and resolve credentialing and enrollment blockers.
 - Develop and maintain SOPs: Build, document, and continuously improve standard operating procedures for credentialing workflows and ensure they are incorporated into day-to-day operations.
✅ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
This role isn’t for everyone. It’s fast-paced, chaotic, and requires hard work. But if this excites you, we’d love to meet you.
 - Extremely organized, with airtight follow-through. You catch issues early and never leave something unresolved without a plan to close it out. Colleagues can trust that once something lands with you — in Slack, email, or a call — it's handled, without needing to be reminded.
 - Proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity. You take initiative without being asked, and when instructions or processes are unclear, you find a path forward and build structure rather than waiting for direction.
 - Sound judgment on urgency and ownership. You know when something is a drop-everything issue versus one that can wait a few hours, and you know what's yours to solve versus what you should escalate.
 - Warm, empathetic communicator. You bring genuine warmth to every conversation — clear, kind, and easy to work with, even with a difficult provider on the other end.
WHY SAILOR HEALTH
 - Mission with impact. Help bring life-changing care to a population that’s too often overlooked.
 - Remote-first team. Enjoy the flexibility of remote work while staying closely connected with a thoughtful, collaborative team rooted in purpose.
 - Growth and ownership. Be part of a small, agile team where you’ll take initiative, shape key processes, and grow as we grow.
 - Make someone’s day – every day. Your work helps older adults and their families feel seen, supported, and cared for.
If this sounds like you, we’d love to connect. Join us in redefining what it means to age with dignity, connection, and mental wellness.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Workplace Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Sei Development Foundation is seeking an experienced, proactive generalist to be a go-to operator across the business and run our physical office in NoHo. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves solving problems independently, and wants to contribute to a fast-moving blockchain company building at the frontier of web3.
We believe the best ideas, strongest relationships, and real sense of belonging come from time spent together. So when our team comes into our office in Noho, we want it to feel like the center of our community. It’s a beautiful space in one of New York’s best neighborhoods, where we do our best work together, host offsites and team gatherings, and celebrate wins.
We’re looking for someone to make it feel alive, and to help the business run smoothly behind the scenes. You’ll create the experiences that make people want to walk through the door, and you’ll also step into whatever the team needs: executive support, events, people operations, finance operations, and general business operations. You’ll balance operational excellence with real hospitality, and culture and community will always be your north star.
You’ll be part of the Operations team, but this role is yours to run. You’re our sole owner of workplace experience, with no facilities team behind you, so you’ll bring a builder’s mindset and the drive to get things done yourself. As a 5 days/week on-site role, you’ll be the steady presence in the office, welcoming people on the days they come in and making each one count.
What you’ll do
Business operations
 - Provide EA-style support as needed: calendar management, travel and logistics, meeting prep, and follow-through
 - Support recruiting logistics: candidate communication, scheduling on-site visits, and a great candidate experience
 - Run new-hire onboarding, including equipment, accounts, and access, and delivering a welcoming first day
 - Support finance ops: expense management, invoices and vendor management, and budget tracking
 - Take on cross-functional special projects and process improvements, such as setting up new systems, running audits, and building workflows
Office operations & vendors
 - Run daily office operations: front-of-house, mail and packages, snacks and supplies, and general upkeep
 - Own vendor and landlord relationships, including sourcing, contracts, renewals, and service quality
 - Be the first point of contact for employee requests and office issues, and resolve them yourself or find who can
 - Manage facilities needs such as space planning, repairs, equipment, and safety compliance
 - Own the office budget: track spend, negotiate pricing, and flag cost-saving opportunities
Events & culture
 - Plan and run team events, including offsites, happy hours, and gatherings
 - Coordinate company-wide moments such as all-hands and milestone celebrations
 - Build in-person rituals and traditions that make the office the center of our community
 - Gather employee feedback and keep improving the workplace experience
What we’re looking for
 - 5-10 years in operations, executive support, chief of staff, office management, or a similar role
 - A true generalist: comfortable going from planning an offsite to reconciling expenses to onboarding a new hire in the same day
 - Track record of working independently as the sole owner of an area
 - Strong vendor management and budgeting skills
 - Experience planning events from start to finish
 - Highly organized and proactive: you spot problems before they’re reported
 - Excellent judgment and discretion with sensitive information
 - Clear, warm communicator who treats colleagues as customers
 - Comfortable in a small company where you’ll wear many hats
 - Able to work on-site at our Manhattan office 5 days a week
 - Experience with workplace and business tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, expense/procurement, HR platforms), and fluency in using AI to work faster
Nice to have
 - Passion for web3 and interest in blockchain ecosystems
 - Experience at a startup or high-growth company
#CG-01

jobs.title: Regulatory Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.
 As a Regulatory Operations Associate , you will handle the day-to-day execution, tracking, and operational tasks required to keep Via’s transit partnerships fully compliant. You will monitor operational workflows, maintain audit-ready documentation, coordinate filings, and support the rollout of internal tools and automated reporting systems across our partner deployments.
 This role is based in NYC with a 3x per week office requirement. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Daily Compliance Execution: Coordinate and submit recurring regulatory filings, vehicle permits, driver credential verifications, and operational reports required by local transit agencies, federal standards (FTA), and accessibility mandates (ADA).
 Audit & Records Maintenance: Maintain centralized documentation systems, log compliance records, and perform routine audits of service data to ensure all partner markets remain 100% audit-ready.
 Tooling & Data Entry Workflows: Utilize internal operational tools, AI-assisted reporting workflows, and databases to extract compliance metrics, log discrepancies, and replace manual paperwork with structured digital tracking.
 Operational Monitoring: Track day-to-day Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and incident reports, flagging non-compliance issues or emerging operational bottlenecks directly to market operations managers.
 Project Coordination: Update and maintain project trackers, compliance calendars, and operational checklists to ensure all milestone dates, renewals, and partner deliverables are completed on schedule.
 Cross-Functional Support: Liaise directly with local Fleet Coordinators, Dispatch, Legal, and Market Operations teams to gather evidence, verify on-the-ground operational facts, and resolve administrative compliance blockers.
 Who You Are 
 1–3 years of professional experience in operations, compliance coordination, program administration, logistics, or a related task-focused operational role; Bachelor's degree required.
 Highly organized task manager who thrives on executing recurring workflows accurately and keeping structured trackers up to date.
 Meticulous attention to detail with a track record of verifying datasets, maintaining clean records, and spotting discrepancies in operational data.
 Clear, practical communicator able to coordinate across frontline operations, legal, and city teams to track down required documentation.
 Fast learner comfortable adopting new software platforms, spreadsheets, and internal workflow tools quickly.
 Prior experience with Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, or compliance tracking software is a plus, but not required.
 Compensation and Benefits 
 Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.
 Salary Range: $65,000 – $85,000 / year
 We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including comprehensive medical plans and 401(k) matching.
 Ready to join the ride?
 Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: IT Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company 
 We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.
 The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.
 Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.
 About the Job 
 Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.
 We're looking for an IT Business Operations Manager to run the business side of technology at Panthalassa. You'll own how we buy, track, and pay for the software and hardware our teams depend on. That means vendor relationships, contracts and renewals, license allocation, the IT budget, and forecasts that stay ahead of a growing company.
 This role is for someone who can read a contract, build a forecast model, and sit down with an engineer to figure out whether they actually need the enterprise tier. You'll partner closely with Finance, Legal, and our IT engineers. Our Business Systems Engineer administers the platforms, and you own the commercial relationship and the spend behind them.
 This is the first dedicated role for this function at Panthalassa. You'll build the processes, reporting, and operating rhythm from the ground up.
 Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.
 Responsibilities 
 Vendor and Contract Management 
 Own relationships with IT software and hardware vendors, including account reviews, escalations, and vendor performance
 Lead renewal and new purchase negotiations with Finance and Legal, including pricing, terms, and multi-year commitments
 Maintain a contract repository and renewal calendar so nothing renews without a decision
 Run new vendor intake with Information Security, including risk review before purchase
 Software Licensing and SaaS Inventory 
 Own the SaaS application inventory, including business owner, license counts, cost, and renewal dates
 Track license utilization, then reclaim, reassign, or right-size unused seats
 Partner with our IAM and Business Systems Engineers so license assignment follows automated provisioning rather than manual requests
 Prepare for and manage vendor true-ups and license audits
 Budget and Forecasting 
 Build and manage the annual IT operating and capital budget with Finance
 Forecast spend against headcount growth, new facilities, and planned projects
 Track actuals against budget monthly, explain variances, and flag risks early
 Code and reconcile IT invoices and purchases with Finance
 Report IT spend to IT leadership and department heads in terms they can act on
 Hardware Asset Lifecycle 
 Own hardware purchasing and vendor relationships for laptops, phones, peripherals, and office technology
 Maintain an accurate asset inventory from purchase through assignment, repair, and disposal
 Plan and budget refresh cycles with our Endpoint Engineer, who owns hardware technical standards
 Coordinate certified disposal and keep records that support audit
 Process and Reporting 
 Build the operating rhythm for the function: renewal calendar, budget reviews, and vendor scorecards
 Own the purchase request and approval workflow for technology, working with our Business Systems Engineer to automate it
 Support the asset and vendor management controls in our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including evidence
 Document processes in Confluence so the next person can pick them up
 Required Qualifications 
 Strong attention to detail: you catch the renewal date, the duplicate invoice, and the seat count that doesn't add up
 Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to keep many workstreams moving at once
 A track record of project or asset management in a software tool, keeping status accurate and responsibilities clearly assigned
 General familiarity with financials and budgeting
 Exceptional external communication: you're comfortable as the primary point of contact for vendors, from routine check-ins to tough conversations
 Skillful written communication, from vendor emails to internal documentation
 A history of strong partnerships with stakeholders across an organization
 Desired Qualifications 
 Familiarity with SaaS business models, including pricing tiers, seat-based licensing, and renewal terms
 Familiarity with information security concepts as they apply to vendors, such as security reviews and data handling
 Familiarity with procurement processes, including purchase approvals, quotes, and purchase orders
 Familiarity with SCIM provisioning and how it ties to license assignment
 The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.
 Additional Requirements 
 Intermittently able to work longer hours around budget cycles and major renewals (flexible PTO and working hours offered)
 If remote, quarterly visits to our HQ office in Portland, OR.
 Compensation and Benefits 
 If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:
 Cash compensation of $130,000 - $150,000.
 Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
 A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
 Flexible paid time off
 Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
 Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
 Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
 Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled)
 Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA
 Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).
 Location 
 This is ideally an on-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop in Portland, Oregon. W

Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.
 Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.
 With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in  Deloitte’s Fast 500  (four years running!),  LinkedIn’s Top Startups ,  Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!),  Inc.’s Best Workplaces , and the  Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index !
 About the Role
 As a Program Coordinator, you will work with some of our largest brands to execute optimized retention marketing strategies across channels, including both SMS and email. By collaborating with our CSM team, you will develop our customer's most ambitious marketing ideas, ensuring they are able to drive growth and conversions with Attentive. Your deep platform knowledge, including experience executing email campaigns, journeys, and transactional messaging, brings value to our customers by ensuring they can get more done. You'll become an Attentive expert, bridging the gap between our product and customers.
 Your core responsibility will be to execute customer projects, ensuring successful partnerships. You will work in conjunction with members of the CSM, Support, and Professional Services teams to maintain alignment on our customers' marketing goals, including the execution and optimization of SMS and email programs.
 This is a hybrid role, expected to work Tuesday-Thursday from our NYC office. 
 What You’ll Accomplish 
 Deliver Attentive Service offerings (Onboarding or Recurring engagements), designed to drive value for our customers
 Leverage your Attentive platform expertise to design and build List Growth tools, Segments, Campaigns, Journeys, Reports, and email sends within the Attentive UI
 Execute and support cross-channel marketing initiatives, including promotional email campaigns, automated journeys, and transactional messaging programs
 Apply channel best practices across SMS and email to improve engagement, conversion, and retention outcomes for customers
 Develop strong relationships with cross-functional team members and our customers
 Manage your assigned accounts in collaboration with Attentive account teams to ensure customers remain engaged and are successful in their adoption of the Attentive platform
 Provide creative solutions and execute swiftly keeping the industry's best practices in mind
 Translate customer feedback into specific product recommendations
 Positioned as a valuable extension of our customers' teams, your attention to detail and quick execution builds trust between us and our customers
 Update internal workflows and documentation so that they remain as accurate as possible
 Your Expertise 
 You have 1-2 years of customer-facing experience in preferably a Customer Success, Support, or Agency role
 Prior experience with SaaS or E-Commerce platforms preferred
 Familiarity with email marketing execution, including campaigns, automated journeys, and transactional messaging, is a strong plus
 You understand the key metrics that Attentive customers are interested in measuring (List Growth, Revenue, Message-Level Performance)
 You are motivated by helping others and derive satisfaction from being part of a team
 You understand how the day to day work delivered by our team directly impacts our customers' progress towards their own goals
 You are a quick learner and ready to get your hands dirty, able to find creative workarounds when faced with limitations
 You are extremely detail oriented, organized, and have a strong ability to prioritize and manage your time effectively
 You are proactive and communicative, never shying away from a quick Slack or Zoom
 You'll get competitive  perks and benefits , from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

 The US base salary range for this full-time position is $56,000 - $70,000 annually + equity + benefits
 Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location

jobs.description:

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 
By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.
 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.
The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

About EliseAI
At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 
By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.
 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
 - Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.
With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.
About The Role
EliseAI is looking for a Revenue Operations Associate to help build and scale the operational infrastructure that powers our Commercial organization. In this role, you’ll work across GTM, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Operations to identify process gaps, improve workflows, support strategic initiatives, and translate business needs into operational and technical solutions to help our teams operate more effectively at scale. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives on detail-oriented, high-volume execution, takes ownership, and enjoys improving systems and workflows in fast-moving environments.
While all Revenue Operations Associates operate cross-functionally across the Commercial organization, candidates will be aligned to a primary operational focus area during the interview process based on business needs, experience, and individual strengths / interests. Associates are expected to develop deep ownership within their designated area while still collaborating broadly across Revenue Operations initiatives.
Current specialization paths include:
 - Deal Strategy & Operations - Scale and execute in-flight deal support, post-sales reconciliation and onboarding workflows, and help build our deal desk motion within a rapidly evolving Quote-to-Cash environment
 - Systems Strategy & Operations - Own and scale critical systems across our GTM tech stack while ensuring data integrity across multiple integrations
 - GTM Strategy & Operations - Partner with GTM leadership to own dashboards & analytics, build and adjust territories, identify process gaps, translate business needs into scalable operational and technical solutions, and drive adoption of new capabilities
Key Responsibilities
 - Design, Manage, and improve processes for Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance teams
 - Partner closely with GTM leaders to identify process gaps, translate needs into technical solutions, and drive adoption of new capabilities

 - Manage sales requests
 - Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

 - Curious and scrappy builder who enjoys figuring things out, automating manual work, and owning projects end-to-end (experience with leveraging AI to efficiently discover, test, and implement solutions)

 - Experience working with Sales and effectively speaking to key processes and data
 - Ability to prioritize effectively and get things done in an unstructured environment
 - Willingness to work in person at our office 5 days a week

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it.  - We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!
Job Compensation Range
The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $130,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
THE ROLE
We’re hiring a Product Operations Manager to join our team and be part of the machine that facilitates product release management for the whole company and our clients.
You’ll own the operating system around releases for a specific product area: what is shipping, when it is ready, who needs to act, and what happens after launch. You’ll also improve how customer feedback and product data reach Product teams, so decisions are based on useful evidence rather than scattered requests.
You’ll need to be exceptionally comfortable with ambiguity and bring a practical, problem-solving mindset. You’ll jump into unfamiliar challenges, learn fast, and turn unclear problems into concrete next steps without waiting for a perfect brief or a ready-made playbook.
This is a hands-on individual-contributor role reporting to the Head of Product Operations. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Support, Product Marketing, Engagement, and customer-facing teams in the US and Europe.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
 - Run release planning and readiness for major launches. Keep scope, owners, dependencies, risks, documentation, communications, and rollout decisions clear.
 - Maintain the company-facing view of the product roadmap and releases, and make sure partner teams have accurate information as plans change.
 - Build and maintain a reliable product-feedback process. Turn requests, support issues, and customer observations into evidence Product teams can prioritise and act on.
 - Track product and release health after launch. Use adoption data, operational metrics, and qualitative feedback to flag problems and recommend next steps.
 - Maintain the product knowledge layer across Notion, documentation as code, and other internal sources of truth. Improve the workflows and automation that keep it current.
 - Use agentic tooling and lightweight code to remove operational friction. Build scripts, ship small fixes, and support analysis without waiting for a dedicated Engineering cycle.
WHO YOU ARE
 - You have 4+ years of experience in product operations, program management, business operations, consulting, technical program management, or a related role.
 - You have run complex launches or programs across Product, Engineering, or go-to-market teams.
 - You bring structure to unclear problems, make ownership explicit, and keep work moving when priorities change.
 - You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams and can influence without formal authority.
 - You are conversant in how software ships: you can work in a codebase, understand pull requests, and use agents to ship small fixes or analysis. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working in code either directly or via agents.
 - Experience with enterprise software, release management, support operations, or product analytics is helpful. Legal experience is not required.
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
 - Broad ownership of how Legora launches and operates its product.
 - Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and go-to-market leaders across regions.
 - The chance to build systems that will shape how the company works as it scales.
 - Competitive compensation, benefits, and participation in Legora’s option program.
 - A New York office built for close, in-person collaboration.
Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer
At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, an d  opera te  with confidence.   
 Trusted by 75% of the top fleets in North America,  Fleetworthy  offers the most adopted toll management solution and largest weigh station bypass network. Going beyond regulatory requirements, our  safety and  compliance capabilities strengthen safety programs and enable proactive audit readiness. We support millions of vehicles and drivers and are recognized across the industry for innovation and leadership.   
 Fleetworthy is shaping the future of fleet readiness with AI-enabled, connected fleet technology that keeps drivers safe, fleets compliant, and operations running at peak efficiency. Learn more at  fleetworthy.com . 
 Job Purpose   
 The Business Operations Coordinator is an entry-level, high-potential role built for a natural systems thinker; someone who's energized by figuring out how the pieces of a complex process connect. Using our CRM and internal data and reporting tools, the Coordinator investigates escalated customer and provider partner issues, digs past the symptom to find the root cause, and partners with toll agencies and internal teams to fix not just the individual case but the process behind it.   
 Deep tolling industry knowledge isn't required on day one; strong analytical instincts and a comfort with technology and data are. This role is designed to build both, developing the Coordinator into a go-to technical troubleshooter within Business Operations.   
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities   
 Investigates escalated customer and provider issues using CRM and internal data tools, tracing each issue to its root cause rather than treating symptoms alone.   
 Approaches problems systemically - mapping how provider data, agency processes, and internal workflows connect to identify where breakdowns actually start.   
 Analyzes case and usage data to spot patterns across issues, surfacing recurring problems and revenue-loss or violation risk before they grow.   
 Collaborates and liaises with Operations and providers to help define technical requirements and provide domain expertise in pursuit of issue closure and continuous process improvement.   
 Partners with Operations, Development, and Product to recommend fixes; a process change, a new report or dashboard, or a product enhancement - accomplished through new technology or alternative use of existing technology.   
 Documents findings and recommendations clearly enough for teammates, managers, and product owners to act on.   
 Engages with customers on an as-needed basis.   
 Maintains broad knowledge about the company's services.   
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of task activities and/or duties that are required of the employee for this job. Responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.   
 Experience and Competencies   
 This is an entry-level position— we're hiring for mindset and potential, not a resume.   
 No prior tolling or transportation experience required (helpful, but not necessary).

jobs.title: Project Manager, Commercialization
jobs.description:
Our Story 
 Launched in 2015, S ol de J aneiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from Brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. S ol de J aneiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.    
 Headquartered in New York and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in Paris, London, and Germany.  Our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of TIME1 00’s 2024 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s 2024 World's Most Innovative Companies, and WWD Beauty Inc’s Power Brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace . These accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace.   
 What You’ll Do 
 The Project Manager, Commercialization independently manages a portfolio of product initiatives from project kickoff through Commercialization Readiness. This role converts business priorities into clear project plans, aligned timelines, accountable actions, and executable launch decisions.   
 The Project Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional leader across Product & Innovation, Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional market teams.   
 This role is accountable for maintaining project momentum, anticipating risks, driving decisions, and ensuring teams remain aligned against key milestones and business commitments. The Project Manager applies consistent governance and operational rigor while adapting to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.   
 This position reports into the Commercialization organization and contributes to stronger, more scalable commercialization practices.   
 What You’ll Be Working On 
 Independent Portfolio Ownership   
 Independently manage a defined portfolio of commercialization projects from kickoff through Commercialization Readiness.   
 Build, maintain , and communicate integrated cross-functional project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.   
 Translate business priorities into clear project plans with defined ownership, timing, and decision requirements.   
 Own the day-to-day project cadence, stakeholder communication, follow-up, and escalation process.   
 Maintain accurate visibility to project status, critical-path activities, open decisions, and readiness.   
 Balance multiple concurrent projects and changing priorities while protecting key business commitments.   
 Cross-Functional Leadership   
 Lead recurring project meetings and working sessions that drive alignment, accountability, and timely execution.   
 Coordinate across Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional teams.   
 Clarify roles, actions, decisions, and due dates so teams understand what is required to move projects forward.   
 Facilitate productive discussions around project trade-offs, dependencies, timing, and execution options.   
 Document decisions and ensure agreed actions are completed or appropriately escalated.   
 Build strong working relationships and influence results without relying on direct authority.   
 Proactive Risk Management   
 Identify project risks, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies early in the commercialization process.   
 Maintain clear risk and decision tracking, including owners, mitigation plans, timing, and business impact.   
 Bring the right stakeholders together to resolve issues before they affect launch timing, production, inventory, cost, regulatory readiness, or commercial commitments.   
 Escalate unresolved risks with clear context, options, recommendations, and required decisions.   
 Monitor changes to scope, timing, cost, or technical requirements and assess downstream impact across the project plan.   
 Maintain transparency so leadership and project teams have an accurate view of project health and priority risks.   
 Operational Rigor & Commercialization Readiness   
 Apply commercialization governance, stage-gate requirements, and readiness criteria consistently across assigned projects.   
 Prepare and facilitate key milestone reviews, stage gates, and Commercialization Readiness discussions.   
 Ensure required deliverables, approvals, decisions, and operational inputs are completed before projects progress.   
 Partner with Supply Planning and Manufacturing to incorporate capacity, production lead times, sourcing requirements, and operational constraints into project plans.   
 Maintain organized project documentation, action logs, decision records, and status reporting.   
 Support a disciplined handoff into operational execution while maintaining communication through launch stabilization.   
 Continuous Improvement   
 Identify recurring execution gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify commercialization ways of working.   
 Apply standard tools, templates, reporting, and governance practices across the portfolio.   
 Capture lessons learned and share practical recommendations that improve future project execution.   
 Support improvements to project management tools, stage-gate processes, readiness criteria, and portfolio reporting.   
 Help strengthen transparency, accountability, decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration across commercialization.   
 Must Haves 
 5-7 years of experience in commercialization, new product development, project management, program management, product innovation, supply chain, or a related cross-functional role.   
 Experience independently managing multiple concurrent projects within a fast-paced, highly cross-functional organization.   
 Beauty, cosmetics, personal care, consumer products, or related industry experience strongly preferred.   
 Strong understanding of the end-to-end product commercialization lifecycle from concept through readiness and launch execution.   
 Experience building and managing integrated project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.   
 Experience leading cross-functional meetings, stage gates, readiness reviews, and decision-making discussions.   
 Demonstrated ability to identify risks early, develop mitigation plans, and escalate issues clearly.   
 Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.   
 Clear and concise communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.   
 Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and maintain momentum through changing priorities.   
 Solutions-oriented mindset with sound judgment and a strong sense of accountability.   
 Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and web-based project or portfolio managemen

jobs.title: Market Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.
We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.
We're looking for a Market and Implementation Specialist at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.
Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.
WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE
You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:
 - Experience coordinating launches, projects, or rollouts from planning through go-live.
 - A track record of keeping multiple moving pieces on track without things slipping through the cracks.
 - Experience building or following readiness checklists, project plans, or similar structured processes.
 - Fluent in project management systems, such as Notion, Monday.com http://Monday.com or AI-based tools to manage projects effectively.
 - Comfort being the point of contact across several teams at once.
 - Comfortable in building simple and easily digestible training manuals and SOPs.
 - A proactive communicator who flags risk early rather than waiting to be asked.
 - Detail-oriented and organized, but able to move fast when a launch timeline is tight.
WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE
This role sits within our Implementation team, reporting to the Implementation Manager. You'll own the operational coordination of every new market and Imaging Center (IC) launch, acting as the connective tissue between Implementation and the functional teams being launched. Early on, your priority is learning the current implementation process end-to-end and successfully coordinating at least one launch from kickoff through stabilization.
As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:
 - Own the market and/or Imaging Center (IC) implementation coordination process, from kickoff through go-live and early stabilization for the operations teams.
 - Build and maintain readiness checklists and go/no-go criteria for every launch.
 - Act as the operational point of contact between Implementation and the teams being launched.
 - Track launch timelines closely, flag risks and blockers early, and escalate before they become delays.
 - Coordinate with Trainers, QA, and WFM to confirm training, quality monitoring, and staffing plans are in place before go-live.
 - Run or support go-live day logistics, troubleshooting issues in real time.
 - Maintain clear, up-to-date launch status reporting for leadership visibility.
 - Document lessons learned after every launch and help turn them into playbook updates.
AI REQUIREMENTS
At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.
Tier 2 — AI-Amplified
For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data.
 - AI is part of your daily default. You use it to draft, analyse, research, and pressure-test your own thinking.
 - You can show concrete examples where AI made your work meaningfully faster or better.
 - You know its failure modes: you check its work, and you don't paste sensitive data into public tools.
Assessment: we'll ask you to walk through how you'd use AI to tackle a real task from the role.
One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.
A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE
We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.
HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU
We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:
 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.
 2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.
 3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com http://Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).
 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
 5. Offer!
WHAT WE OFFER
We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:
 - Salary range of $80,000 - $90,000
 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options
 - Dedicated personal development budget
 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage
 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best
 - Paid parental leave
 - 401k retirement plan
 - All the equipment you need to do your best work
 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team
 - Atlanta office perks: Complimentary team lunch every Wednesday, on-site gym access, roof terrace, and on-site lunch options
DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com
Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.
 About the Role 
 The Program Coordinator, School Operations (internal title: Senior Associate, School Operations)  is an experienced professional who serves as a critical driver for systems and continuous improvement across the network. Reporting directly to the Leader of School Operations Process Improvement, you will be responsible for the seamless development, execution, and continuous iteration of core operational programs and policies that ensure a high bar of quality and consistency across all our schools.
 This role requires a blend of specialized program management skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. You will be the primary point person for translating strategic operational priorities into clear, actionable, and consistently executed standard work for our school-based operations teams, directly impacting areas such as school safety, quality assurance, technology integration, and financial compliance.
 Key Responsibilities 
 The Senior Associate will own and drive the following core workstreams and responsibilities:
 Operational Program Management & Scaling: 
 Lead the end-to-end management of critical network-wide operations programs 
 Own the development, maintenance, and dissemination of core operational standard work and playbooks 
 Manage operational deliverables communicated to schools via the project management platform (Trello), ensuring clear guidance, timely publishing, and consistent follow-up on completion rates. 
 Systems and Technology Implementation: 
 Partner closely with the Technology team (CX Tech, SIS) to support the network-wide rollout of operational technology enhancements. 
 Design and document system improvements to streamline and automate school-based processes, ensuring technology platforms reduce administrative burden and enhance efficiency. 
 Policy and Compliance Oversight: 
 Drive cross-functional initiatives to codify and clarify network policies with operational implications. 
 Analyze and report on school compliance and performance against operational metrics. 
 Act as the Operations point-of-contact in cross-functional meetings, ensuring operational systems align with requirements from network partners. 
 Data Analysis & Quality Assurance: 
 Conduct data collection, analysis, and reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality metrics. 
 Prepare and present executive memos and resources that summarize program results, trends, and next steps for school leadership and network partners. 
 Qualifications 
 A minimum of 2-3 years of professional experience in project/program management, operations, or a related highly analytical role. Experience in an education or high-growth environment is preferred. 
 Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects from concept to launch, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and drive high-quality outcomes. 
 Expert-level attention to detail and organizational skills, particularly in developing clear, rigorous standard work, policies, and system documentation. 
 Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, comfortable working with compliance data, performance metrics, and system usage reports. 
 Exceptional communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to effectively communicate technical, policy, and compliance changes to diverse audiences. 
 Ability to work independently with minimal guidance and effectively manage multiple competing priorities. 
 Proficiency with project management and data analysis tools (e.g., Trello, Salesforce, Excel/Google Sheets). 
 Compensation, Benefits, & Perks
