jobs.title: Event Project Manager, Corporate Meetings & Events
jobs.description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!
The Opportunity
The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing the complex lifecycle of AV production and creative design projects for our clients' most important events.
This person will work with clients across the Tech, Finance, Pharma, and Non-Profit spaces, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You aren't just managing tasks; you are a consultant and a brand steward for our clients’ most vital internal and client-facing events, leading the information flow across all parties. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the executive presence to guide stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients' vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.
This role requires frequent to moderate onsite travel (approximately 20-30%, or 4-5 days per month).
What You'll Own
Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll lead numerous events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV Production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, while expertly preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 20-30%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while maintaining high energy in fast-paced event environments.
What We Need
4-7+ Years of Event Industry Experience: You’ve navigated the agency or white-glove event world and have a customer-focused mindset.
Organization & Speed: You’re a fast-paced multitasker who is accountable to deadlines and finds joy in the details.
Great Communicator. You’re able to communicate clearly and effectively both verbally and in writing.
People person. You’re able to build relationships and cater your approach depending on the person you’re talking to. You’re experienced in working with different personalities and professional levels.
Technical & Creative Curiosity: You’re ready to dive into AV production and creative service logistics.
Adaptability. You can confidently work and make decisions in gray, unpredictable spaces with shifting priorities. When faced with unforeseen challenges, you adjust to keep the project (and everybody) on track.
Values Alignment: You demonstrate kindness, commitment, and humility in everything you do.
The Impact
Within 1 month, you’ll:
Learn about MT’s services - the value we offer, the types of events that we service and our customer-service mentality.
Have opportunities for training to expand your exposure and understanding of how we manage events at Meeting Tomorrow
Meet with current members of the Project Management, Production, Creative, and Sales teams to understand best practices for supporting our clients and their diverse needs.
Within 3 months, you’ll:
Build strong and lasting relationships with clients and internal team members, ensuring a strong client retention rate.
Begin to create your own processes for working with your clients and identify opportunities for efficiency/improvement. 
Become proficient in our CRM, Netsuite and Project Planning tool, Backstage.
Work with members of our internal support teams to effectively manage a large-scale event or event series for premier clients. These clients include Fortune-5000 companies in many sectors including pharmaceutical, wealth management, and production service agencies.
Within 6 months you’ll:
Have proficiency in the role and be managing accounts with autonomy.
Complete projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
Demonstrate an aptitude for problem solving and contingency planning; striving to consistently exceed client expectations.
Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision plan options
Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
401k with employer matching up to 4%
16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
Annual profit-sharing bonus
12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
$50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
Regular social events and learning opportunities
At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourages BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.
What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!

jobs.title: Enterprise Project Manager
jobs.description:
Compass Surgical Partners is a leading, independent, full-service ambulatory surgery center (ASC) development and management partner. An exclusive partner for premier health systems, Compass has built a nationwide portfolio of ASC joint ventures with health systems and physicians. Compass’ experienced leadership team has developed more than 250 ASCs over the past three decades, making it the partner of choice for high-performance ASCs. Differentiated by a proven track record of success and an agile, aligned operating model, Compass Surgical Partners aims to create strong partnerships that improve the lives of patients and providers. Learn more at www.compass-sp.com http://www.compass-sp.com.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Compass Surgical Partners is seeking an Enterprise Project Manager to bring structure, visibility, and accountability to key strategic initiatives across the organization. This role will partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure projects are clearly defined, actively managed, and executed with discipline.
The Enterprise Project Manager will help translate priorities into actionable plans, drive alignment across stakeholders, identify risks before they become roadblocks, and provide leaders with clear visibility into project progress, dependencies, and decisions.
This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex organizational challenges, and can balance attention to detail with a strong focus on outcomes.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Project Planning and Execution
 - Lead enterprise-wide projects from planning through execution
 - Develop actionable project plans with clear milestones and ownership
 - Manage timelines and dependencies while proactively addressing risks and resource constraints
 - Drive follow-through on decisions and commitments across teams
 - Anticipate challenges and help teams resolve obstacles to keep projects moving
Stakeholder Alignment and Communication
 - Partner with executive and functional leaders to align priorities and facilitate timely decisions
 - Facilitate project meetings and working sessions that produce clear next steps
 - Prepare executive-level dashboards and updates that communicate progress and project health
 - Ensure stakeholders understand upcoming milestones and where decisions or support are needed
 - Support organizational change by helping teams adopt new processes and ways of working
Tools and Process Improvement
 - Build and maintain project management tools and reporting frameworks that improve visibility and accountability
 - Support intake and prioritization processes for new initiatives
 - Recommend practical process improvements that strengthen execution without adding unnecessary complexity
 - Leverage AI tools to streamline documentation and reporting while automating routine project tasks
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
 - 5+ years of experience in project management, operations, consulting, business transformation, integration management, or a related field
 - Healthcare experience required; experience within an ASC, physician practice, MSO, or healthcare services organization strongly preferred
 - Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
 - Experience partnering with executive leaders and influencing outcomes across all levels of an organization
 - Strong project planning, organization, and execution skills
 - Ability to identify risks, dependencies, decision points, and stakeholder alignment gaps before they impact delivery
 - Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, build alignment, and manage competing priorities
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and presentations
 - Experience creating and managing project plans, dashboards, trackers, status reports, and related project management tools
 - Ability to operate independently, take initiative, and drive accountability across teams
 - Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment in dynamic, fast-changing environments
 - Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools
 - Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve productivity and execution while applying sound judgment to accuracy and confidentiality
WHY COMPASS SURGICAL PARTNERS
Compass Surgical Partners develops and manages ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) in partnership with physicians and health systems. We’re builders and operators committed to patient value, physician partnership, and scalable excellence. You’ll join a team that works with clear outcomes, moves fast, and supports each other through our STAR values—Service, Teamwork, Accountability, and Respect (respect through directness, kindness, and ownership).
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Compass Surgical Partners is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or hiring process, please contact us at info@compass-sp.com.
E-VERIFY
Compass Surgical Partners participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with information from your Form I-9 to confirm your authorization to work in the United States.
If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, we are required to provide you with written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or the Social Security Administration (SSA) before taking any adverse employment action.
For more information, please review the E-Verify Participation Poster https://www.e-verify.gov/sites/default/files/everify/posters/EVerifyParticipationPoster.pdf and the Right to Work Poster https://www.e-verify.gov/sites/default/files/everify/posters/IER_RighttoWorkPoster.pdf?utm=
COMPENSATION & PAY TRANSPARENCY
Salary ranges at Compass are based on role, level, and location, and may vary by state. Individual pay is determined by work location and factors such as relevant skills, experience, and education or training. Your recruiter will provide the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. In addition to base salary, many roles are eligible for an annual performance-based bonus. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and company and individual performance.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Medical Communications (Commercial)
jobs.description:
About Lockwood:  Lockwood collaborates with clients in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries to identify effective, holistic, science-based strategies to address their objectives through medical communications. Our clients count on us to challenge their assumptions and help them creatively navigate around obstacles. From strategy through execution, we focus on accuracy, transparency, and scientific value to create programs that are evidence-based, clinically relevant, and contribute to the development of our clients’ brands. Over a third of our staff hold advanced scientific or medical degrees, and most work from where they live. Because our flexible structure provides better work-life balance, we attract the best talent, facilitate their best work, and as a result, are more responsive to our clients, wherever and whenever they do business.
 Summary: In this role, the Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of medical communications projects from inception to completion, including but not limited to, content development, advisory boards, and speaker training.
 Responsibilities include facilitating multidisciplinary project teams, interfacing with each department within the company, meeting client and management expectations, establishing strong faculty relationships, and ensuring programs remain on target and within agreed-upon parameters. The Project Manager is responsible for budget development, maintenance and reconciliation, managing external suppliers, keeping programs on time and focused on primary objectives, providing ongoing updates to internal team members and client contact(s), and resource management. The number of simultaneous programs managed by each Project Manager is dependent on the scope and nature of each initiative.
 The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with experience successfully leading multidisciplinary teams. We are seeking individuals with strong financial management skills who are highly organized, adept at multitasking/prioritizing, and have the ability and willingness to motivate others.
 Responsibilities: 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and faculty members
 Maintain and manage timely and professional written and verbal communications with clients and faculty members
 Ensure client expectations are met on all levels of program activity
 Establish and maintain a strong knowledge of client organizations, products, disease states, and medical education
 Develop new project budgets
 Contribute to new business development activities within the account team
 Manage budgeting, financial monitoring, and reconciliation of individual projects
 Schedule and conduct start-up, interim, and final team meetings for each project, establish and maintain time and events schedules, and provide ongoing updates to client and team as required by account team on each initiative to ensure successful management and completion
 Facilitate progress of multidisciplinary project teams to ensure within-budget, on-time, on-strategy performance
 Own the detail of daily account work on each project
 Oversee and facilitate development of all project activities, including faculty recruitment and ongoing communication, audience generation, content development, logistics management, registration/participant communication, production of materials, supplier performance, central file management
 Assist in training new account team members as required
 Maintain company policies as they pertain to all activities
 Adhere to all Lockwood Group policies and standard operating procedures
 Education: A bachelor’s degree is required.
 Professional Skills & Experience:  
 Three to five years of relevant project management experience in a healthcare communications environment is required .
 Candidates must have the ability to grasp and retain scientific information, along with a strong technical aptitude and working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Access.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Associate

Practice Operations Associate 
 Location: Remote
 Employment Type: Full-time, W2 Hourly, non-exempt, benefits eligible
 Compensation : $20-23/hour
 About FamilyWell 
 FamilyWell's mission is to transform women's mental health across the reproductive journey, from fertility through menopause. We embed evidence-based, insurance-covered mental health care directly into women's health practices, making mental health support available where patients already receive care.
 By integrating a virtual team of care managers, coaches, therapists, and psychiatric providers into clinical workflows, FamilyWell is expanding access to mental health support, improving outcomes for women and families, and reducing the administrative burden for our provider partners.
 About the Role 
 FamilyWell is seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Practice Operations Associate to support the day-to-day administrative operations of our growing mental health care program.
 In this role, you will help ensure that patient referrals, medical records, insurance information, and clinical documentation are processed accurately and efficiently. You'll work closely with our clinical, operations, and billing teams to support seamless coordination of care and maintain strong relationships with our partnering healthcare practices.
 This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys creating order and efficiency, and takes pride in ensuring that important details are handled accurately and on time.
 What You'll Do 
 Patient Referrals & Registration 
 Process incoming patient referrals and ensure timely, accurate entry into patient management systems.
 Collect, verify, and maintain patient demographic, insurance, and referral information.
 Support patient registration and onboarding processes.
 Identify and resolve missing or incomplete information to help patients access care without unnecessary delays.
 Coordinate with internal teams and partner practices to address referral-related questions or issues.
 Medical Records & Documentation 
 Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date patient records across electronic health record (EHR) and practice management systems.
 Support the timely exchange of clinical documentation with referring providers and partner practices.
 Update patient information, appointment records, and other relevant documentation as needed.
 Identify and resolve discrepancies in patient records to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
 Ensure all documentation is handled in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.
 Insurance & Billing Support 
 Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits to support timely access to care.
 Identify insurance coverage issues and coordinate with the appropriate team members to resolve them.
 Assist with routine billing-related administrative tasks, including processing applicable patient charges.
 Collaborate with billing and operations teams to address administrative issues that may affect reimbursement or the patient experience.
 Practice Operations & Administrative Support 
 Provide day-to-day administrative support to clinical and operations teams.
 Monitor and manage administrative workflows to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.
 Communicate with internal team members and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.
 Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and reduce administrative burden.
 Assist with reporting, data management, and other operational projects as needed.
 What You Bring 
 Required Qualifications 
 At least 2 years of experience in healthcare administration, with a focus on insurance eligibility and benefits verification, revenue cycle management (RCM), or related medical practice operations.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
 Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 Comfort working with electronic health records, practice management systems, and other digital tools.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote, fast-paced environment.
 Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.
 A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new processes and systems.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in behavioral health, women's health, or a related healthcare setting.
 Familiarity with insurance eligibility verification and medical billing processes.
 Experience working with multiple EHR or practice management platforms.
 Proficiency with spreadsheets, data entry, and basic reporting.
 Experience supporting a growing healthcare organization or multi-site medical practice.
 What Success Looks Like 
 In this role, success means:
 Patient referrals and registration information are processed accurately and promptly.
 Medical records and clinical documentation are complete, organized, and up to date.
 Insurance and administrative issues are identified and resolved proactively.
 Clinical teams and partner practices receive timely, reliable administrative support.
 Patient information is managed securely and in accordance with privacy requirements.
 You contribute to efficient, scalable workflows that support a positive patient and provider experience.
 Why Join FamilyWell? 
 At FamilyWell, we believe every woman deserves access to high-quality mental health care, regardless of where she is in her reproductive journey.
 As a Practice Administrator, you'll play an essential role in making that care possible. Your work behind the scenes will help ensure that patients receive timely support, clinicians can focus on delivering excellent care, and our partner practices have a seamless experience working with FamilyWell.
 You'll join a mission-driven, collaborative, and growing team committed to improving women's mental health and transforming the healthcare experience.
 FamilyWell Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. 
 Please be aware of recruitment scams. FamilyWell will never ask candidates to pay money, request sensitive personal information early in the process, or conduct interviews over unsecured platforms. All official communication will come from an @ familywellhealth.com email address.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Motley Fool Asset Management
jobs.description:
Who are we? 
 Motley Fool Asset Management (MFAM) brings The Motley Fool's decades of investing expertise to professionally managed ETFs, helping investors put our long-term, high-conviction investing philosophy to work without having to manage individual stocks themselves. As a growing business within The Motley Fool, we combine the entrepreneurial spirit of a scaling asset manager with the strength of a trusted financial brand.
 We're passionate about thoughtful investing, continuous improvement, and delivering an exceptional experience for our clients- and we're looking for people who are excited to help shape what's next.
 What would you do in this role? 
 We are seeking an experienced, organized Project Manager to work across the entire company, giving every team a shared view of what is in flight, what is due, and what is blocked. You will be the owner of our project portfolio in Jira, building the structure, cadence, and reporting that keep teams aligned and deliverables on schedule. This is a hands-on role that calls for someone who knows Jira inside and out and who understands how an asset manager operates.
 But what does this role actually do? 
 Project Management: 
 Track and manage company-wide projects from initiation to completion using Jira.
 Coordinate with team leads across portfolio management, trading, operations, compliance, legal, marketing and tech to ensure milestones are met.
 Monitor timelines and adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or delays.
 Dependency and Blocker Management: 
 Identify cross-team dependencies early and make sure each team knows what it owns, what is due, and what it is blocking.
 Escalate blockers to leadership before they cause delays.
 Maintain a clear view of risks, issues, and team capacity.
 Jira Administration and Automation: 
 Design and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, filters, and dashboards that fit how the firm works.
 Set up automation rules and intake forms for status notifications, overdue reminders, and new project requests.
 Keep Jira data accurate and consistent so it serves as the single source of truth.
 Documentation and Reporting: 
 Maintain up-to-date project documentation, including runbooks and process guides.
 Deliver a consistent weekly view of portfolio health, timelines, and risks to leadership.
 Continuous Improvement: 
 Identify opportunities to streamline how projects are taken, prioritized, and tracked.
 Recommend and implement lightweight best practices.
 What do you need to apply? 
 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably in asset management, ETFs, or financial services.
 Expert-level Jira experience, including administration, workflows, dashboards, and automation.
 Working knowledge of the ETF lifecycle and the functions around it (portfolio management, trading, operations, compliance, distribution) is strongly preferred.
 Excellent organizational and multitasking skills.
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams and levels of seniority.
 Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
 Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
 We estimate the above services & deliverables to take no more than 20-25 hours a week.

jobs.title: Release Manager
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.  Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! 
 About Tailscale  
 Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.
 About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Release Manager to own how Tailscale ships our product, both internally and to customers. You’ll build and run our release coordination process and create the operational practices that coordinate product and engineering.
 You’ll work closely with engineering leads, product managers, TPMs and support. At first you’ll focus on building release management from the ground up: setting the release cadence, defining roles, building tooling, and agreeing on norms with the teams involved in releases. Later, it will grow into creating processes around other parts of how product and engineering collaborate, like operational metrics.
 You should understand how software gets shipped, including branching strategies, build pipelines, feature flags, and rollout mechanics. Your technical aptitude will allow you to design release processes that engineers trust and use.
 Tailscale moves fast and your processes should help us maintain our speed. When a process works well, it is nearly invisible - it keeps the right people informed, stays out of engineers’ way, and gives the team a plan.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, implement, and continuously improve Tailscale’s release management process: including release cadence, readiness criteria, rollout coordination, and go/no-go decisions
 Build and maintain the tooling, templates, runbooks, and documentation that make release processes repeatable and low-friction
 Partner with engineering leads and product managers to surface risk early and drive resolution before it becomes a crisis
 Define and track operational metrics that reflect the health of our release practices (e.g., release frequency, change failure rate)
 Keep releases on schedule by facilitating cross-team planning rituals that keep engineering and product coordinated
 Identify and drive systemic improvements to how we operate, using data and judgment to prioritize what actually matters
 What We Are Looking For
 5+ years in engineering operations, release management, or a closely related role at a software company
 Direct experience building or significantly improving release management processes
 Technical fluency: you understand software development deeply enough to have credible conversations with engineers about build systems, deployment pipelines, branching strategies, and production operations
 Strong instincts for what process is worth having and what’s just overhead, and optimizing process for trust and adoption
 Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to build structure from scratch
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with both client and server software release processes
 Experience at a developer tools, infrastructure, or security-focused SaaS company
 Familiarity with DORA metrics and how to use them to drive meaningful improvement
 Experience with feature flag systems, progressive rollouts, or canary deployments as release tools
 Experience scaling operational practices through periods of rapid team or product growth
 Hands-on experience with Tailscale at work or home

 What We Offer 
 An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.

Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. 
 Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
 Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.  Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!

jobs.location: United States; New Brunswick; Jersey City
jobs.description:
About Pulley
Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. 
Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.
We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.
Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.
The Role
You must be located in New Jersey to be considered for this role.
Our in-house permitting team is a key function for driving fast, reliable permitting outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will:
 - Support our lead project managers in delivering great permitting outcomes for customers
 - Help conduct permit research with a high degree of accuracy
 - Assist in preparing permit plans
 - Collaborate with city staff on nuances and ambiguities
 - Monitor permit status and ensure timely responses
 - Provide feedback to product & engineering teams to help refine our software platform
 - Work with permitting leadership to refine our standard operating procedures
Who You Are
To be successful in this role, you are likely someone with:
 - 3+ years of professional experience in architecture, ideally with hands-on experience in construction documentation, permitting, and project coordination
 - Bachelor's degree in Architecture or a related field preferred
 - Direct experience preparing, submitting, and obtaining building permits
 - Strong understanding of architectural drawings, construction documents, and the building permitting process
 - Ability to independently research permit requirements with a high degree of accuracy
 - Comfortable communicating with city staff and navigating administrative processes
 - Clear communicator with strong attention to detail
 - Proactive problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment
Compensation
$80,000 - $95,000 base + Equity

Company Overview 
 At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company’s long-term success. 
 Job Summary 
 The Project Manager is a key figure of the project team, responsible for the overall success of a project. The incumbent must possess excellent leadership skills, as well as be able to successfully set, observe and re-evaluate project priorities frequently. 
 Responsibilities 
 Responsible for overseeing the efforts of all project activities and personnel. 
 Coordinate with Estimating Department to formulate award schedule for trades during pre-construction. 
 Acquire a thorough understanding of project requirements and objectives; review all project documents, including drawings, specifications, contracts, scope of work, and construction schedule and manage compliance with these requirement and objectives. 
 Coordinate and facilitate both internal and building kick-off meeting with all key participants. 
 Prepare and issue project documents including progress reports, detailed project schedule updates, and financial/budget updates. 
 Maintain good relationships with owners, subcontractors, unions and other interested parties. Initiate periodic meetings and other forms of communication with project team members and/or client as appropriate, to acquaint them with unresolved problems and to ensure an adequate degree of coordination as needed between disciplines. 
 Forecast and track the amount of labor, managerial and material costs necessary to complete a project. 
 Perform project status reviews by monitoring project schedule, submittal/RFI logs and open items 
 Monitor project scope for changes affecting budget and/or schedule; identifies cause, advises client, and negotiates changes in fee as appropriate. 
 Manage project budget, minimize, and track expenses; provide finance reporting as needed. 
 Ensure timely and accurate invoicing, monitor receivables for project as well as subcontractor pay schedule. 
 Ensure subcontractors provide certificates of insurance that meet contractual requirements prior to mobilization. 
 Resolve subcontractor claims during subcontractor close-out period. 
 Ensure punchlist completion and Department of Buildings sign off. 
 Organize and deliver project close-out/As-Built documents.

 At least five years of relevant experience as a Project Manager, preferably experience building for city and/or state agencies

 Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook), Procore (preferred but not required), and Timberline (preferred but not required)

jobs.title: Centre Sales & Operations Coordinator – Varese (Tempo determinato – 30h/settimana)
jobs.description:
Il ruolo in breve 
 A fine novembre apriamo a Varese il primo GoStudent Learning Centre della città, dove gli studenti trovano lezioni in presenza, di gruppo e online in un unico posto. Cerchiamo una persona piena di energia e con una naturale predisposizione al contatto con le persone, che porti le famiglie nel nuovo centro e lo faccia funzionare ogni giorno.
 È un ruolo operativo: sarai tu a chiamare le famiglie, visitare le scuole, accogliere i genitori e iscrivere gli studenti in prima persona.
 Sede: Varese (in presenza)
 Contratto: Tempo determinato, 12 mesi
 Orario 
 L'orario standard è di 30 ore settimanali, con la possibilità di concordare 20 ore settimanali o il tempo pieno. La maggior parte del lavoro si svolge nel pomeriggio (circa 16:00–20:00), quando studenti e famiglie sono al centro. La mattina e le ore prima dell'apertura sono dedicate a chiamate, visite nelle scuole e preparazione. Attività occasionali nel weekend (es. open day o eventi locali) solo quando necessario, non tutti i fine settimana.
 Retribuzione e bonus 
 Una retribuzione annua lorda fissa, in base alle ore settimanali:
 20h/settimana: 13.333,33 €
 30h/settimana: 20.000 €
 40h/settimana: 26.666,67 €
 🚀 E in più un bonus: fai crescere il tuo centro, fai crescere i tuoi guadagni! 
Guadagna dal 5% al 9% del Gross Profit mensile del tuo centro, man mano che cresce la base di studenti attivi.
 Sulla base di uno scenario di crescita illustrativo, il tuo bonus aggiuntivo potrebbe essere in media di:
 Primo anno: ~450 €/mese
 Secondo anno: ~1.900 €/mese
 Le proiezioni del bonus sono puramente illustrative, non garantite, e dipendono dai risultati effettivi del centro e dal Gross Profit. 
 La tua settimana tipo 
 Chiamare e ricontattare le famiglie che hanno mostrato interesse per GoStudent
 Visitare scuole, società sportive e associazioni del territorio, distribuire volantini e creare partnership locali
 Organizzare open day e lezioni di prova, incontrare i genitori e chiudere le iscrizioni in prima persona
 Seguire le famiglie per assicurarti che gli studenti siano soddisfatti e restino con noi
 Organizzare gli orari di studenti e tutor e far funzionare il centro senza intoppi
 Monitorare i tuoi numeri settimanali (lead, lezioni di prova, iscrizioni) insieme al tuo manager
 Cosa porti con te 
 Esperienza a contatto diretto con i clienti: vendita, customer service, insegnamento, ripetizioni, retail o hospitality
 Hai già acquisito clienti in prima persona e sai raccontarci come l'hai fatto e con quali risultati
 Tanta energia e sicurezza: ti piace alzare il telefono e parlare con persone che ancora non conosci
 Un approccio pratico: ti piace fare le cose in prima persona, non delegarle
 Capacità organizzativa per gestire chiamate, visite e attività quotidiane del centro
 L'esperienza con studenti o genitori è un grande plus
 Vivi a Varese o nei dintorni (Gallarate, Malnate, Tradate, Induno Olona, Castiglione Olona)
 Italiano fluente (C2); l'inglese è un plus
 Questo ruolo fa per te? 
 Questo ruolo non fa per te se cerchi di gestire un team o di occuparti di strategia. Qui sei tu a far succedere le cose ogni giorno, e vedrai i risultati del tuo lavoro direttamente nella crescita del tuo centro.
 Riporterai all'Head of Revenue Italy.
 Il nostro impegno per l'inclusione 
 Valorizziamo le tue competenze e la tua motivazione. Non facciamo distinzioni di età, genere, nazionalità o opinioni politiche. Se credi di poter avere un impatto positivo, candidati anche se non hai tutti i requisiti: la diversità ci rende più creativi, innovativi e forti.
 Come candidarsi 
 Carica il tuo CV in formato PDF, in italiano o in inglese. 🚀
 Informativa privacy e compliance

jobs.title: Project Manager, Repairs
jobs.description:
About Homeward
 Homeward takes the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that give buyers and sellers certainty and convenience. We’re a fast-paced, remote-first real estate startup that partners with real estate agents to offer innovative products and services, helping clients buy with cash, sell with certainty, and time their move, regardless of the market.
 Founder and CEO Tim Heyl, owner of one of the fastest-growing agent teams in the country, started Homeward in 2018 to fix the antiquated and broken real estate process. Today, we offer bundled cash offers, mortgage, and title services in 13 states, enabling buyers and sellers to move with certainty and convenience.
 We’re a fully remote company with a diverse team spread across several countries - Grounded in three core values: The Golden Rule, One Team One Dream, and Calm Focus. Hear from our employees about what our values mean to them .
 The Opportunity 
 Homeward is building a stronger, faster, and more accountable Repairs organization. The Repairs Project Manager (PM) will own repair performance for an assigned portfolio of homes and serve as the construction subject matter expert for their pod(s). This role combines residential construction knowledge, project management, vendor negotiation, problem solving, and strong operational ownership to deliver against a key set of KPIs.
 The PM will work closely with Homeward's market teams, approved vendors, and Property Coordinators to move homes through repairs quickly, at the right quality and at the right cost. This is not an administrative coordinator role—the PM is expected to make decisions, challenge scopes and pricing, solve complex repair issues, and own the outcome.
 What You'll Do: 
 Own repair performance for an assigned pod/portfolio from vacancy through Make Ready completion and throughout the property's lifecycle while it’s in Homeward’s possession.
 Serve as the construction SME for repair scoping, pricing, vendor questions, complex repairs, and escalations.
 Review and pressure-test repair scopes to ensure work is necessary, appropriately scoped, and consistent with Homeward standards to deliver a strong ROI.
 Negotiate vendor pricing, enforce established pricing tables, use Not-to-Exceed (NTE) limits, and seek competitive bids when appropriate.
 Make practical, time-sensitive field decisions within defined authority so vendors can complete additional minor work while already onsite instead of creating unnecessary return trips.
 Take a lead role on Market Sale repairs, where closing timelines require fast scoping, vendor coordination, and decision-making.
 Lead emergency repair coordination, ensuring rapid vendor dispatch, timely mitigation of property damage, and effective communication with internal stakeholders through resolution.
 Coordinate the filing and management of property insurance claims, including documenting losses, gathering supporting information, working with adjusters and vendors, and following claims through resolution.
 Manage vendors at the project level and hold them accountable to price, quality, and Estimated Completion Dates (ECDs).
 Partner with Property Coordinators, who handle administrative and workflow execution such as utilities, recurring maintenance, invoice/document management, system updates, and routine coordination.
 Review completed work and QC information, identify incomplete or poor-quality work, and drive corrective action (inclusive of rework demands).
 Provide actionable vendor-performance feedback to Repairs leadership and assist with identifying strong local vendors and direct-to-trade options such as plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, and other specialty trades.
 Partner with GMs and our property listing teams  on repair strategy, including whether work is necessary, how it should be scoped, and how to resolve repair requests efficiently.
 Owner mindset around escalations - leverage your  construction judgment, assess vendor performance, scope, cost, quality, and schedule to determine the best path forward for Homeward and its customer.
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 Residential construction, renovation, fix-and-flip, SFR, property management, iBuyer, general contracting, or similar hands-on housing experience.
 Strong working knowledge of common residential repair and renovation scopes, materials, trades, sequencing, and pricing.
 Ability to look at a repair problem and develop practical, cost-effective solutions—not simply accept the first vendor recommendation.
 Experience working directly with contractors and vendors, including negotiating bids and holding partners accountable.
 Strong judgment and comfort making decisions with imperfect information and tight timelines.
 Ability to manage multiple active properties and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to translate construction issues for non-construction partners.
 Comfort working with remote/offshore operational partners and providing clear direction and context.
 Bias toward ownership: if a project is off track, you identify why and drive it to resolution.
 Experience managing dispersed residential portfolios across multiple markets.
 Nice-to-Haves: 
 Experience with an SFR operator, iBuyer, institutional homebuyer, fix-and-flip organization, or residential renovation platform.
 Experience sourcing specialty trades and building local vendor networks.
 Residence in or near a major Homeward market, creating the ability to make occasional property/site visits if needed in the future.
 Compensation:
 Base salary of $70,000
 Variable Performance bonus up to $15,000
 Meaningful equity grant of stock options with real upside potential
 Benefits:
 Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, with company contributions toward premiums
 20 days of paid vacation, 5 sick days, 12 company holidays, and 2 floating holidays
 Generous paid parental leave of up to 13 weeks
 401(k) with employer contribution match
 Remote-first work environment (our headquarters are in Austin, TX)
 Collaborative, low-ego team that values intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement

About the Role
 Cents is looking for an Onboarding Representative to help new operators go live on Cents as quickly, efficiently, and confidently as possible. Your top priority is getting operators up and running on Cents POS so they can start placing orders and taking payments right away.  This position is open to remote candidates, but core hours must overlap 9am–5pm ET, Monday through Friday. For applicants in New York - we're a hybrid team that works together in our NYC office three days a week. Our in-office anchor days are Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday , when you'll find the broader team collaborating, meeting, and connecting in person. Tuesdays and Fridays are remote, giving you dedicated time for focused work while still maintaining the flexibility of a hybrid schedule.
Key Responsibilties
 Get new operators live on Cents POS as quickly as possible so they can start placing orders and transacting right away
 Train operators and their teams on how to use all Cents products, and show them the value of each one so they get started as soon as possible
 Teach operators how to edit their websites and set up their own configurations across Cents products, including new products as they launch

 Provide incredible customer service during every interaction with clients

 Ad hoc responsibilities as needed

 B.A, B.S. or equivalent degree
 At least 6 months to 1 year of customer service, customer success, or inside sales experience
 Experience in SaaS and CRM platforms is preferred, but not required
 Tech-savviness with an ability to conduct presentations virtually using Zoom and troubleshoot any complications that arise as a result
 Organizational skills, detail, and task-oriented
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Self starter & Team player mindset
 Ability to work effectively in a fast paced environment
Nice to Haves
 Experience training or onboarding customers on software, either virtually or in person
 Comfort explaining technical products to customers with any level of tech experience
 Familiarity with the laundry, dry cleaning, or small business services industry

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.
ABOUT ONEBRIEF
Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.
Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.
We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.
Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.
PRODUCT OPERATIONS MANAGER
OVERVIEW
As a Product Operations Manager at Onebrief, you own whether the deployed product works the way we intend. You connect customers, product, engineering, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams. You build the systems, data pipelines, and automations that help us ship with confidence in high-stakes, mission-critical environments.
This is a hands-on, technical role. You will build 0→1 processes and tools, and use AI and automation to run them at scale.
WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE
Signal & Insight
 - Build customer feedback channels and usage and satisfaction measures (feature-usage telemetry, NPS/CSAT), and turn that data into roadmap input.
 - Build dashboards for exec, support, and engineering, with automated self-checks so they stay accurate without manual audits.
Reliability
 - Own the bug database, including intake, triage, severity levels, resolution targets, and a regular review cadence. Drive the top customer-impacting issues to resolution.
 - Define and ship in-product quality-of-service measures (load delays, timeouts, crashes, failed logins), and work with InfraSec to plan STIG, POA&M, and security fixes into the roadmap.
Release Governance
 - Define entry and exit criteria, sign-off owners, and rollback triggers for Pilot, Early Access, and General Availability. Own feature flags, rollback procedures, and release notes.
 - Keep one shared view of what is shipping, to whom, and when, and report it weekly in CR OpSync. Bring InfraSec in early on high-side and ATO impacts, and produce enablement materials for Sales and Customer Relations.
Process & Tooling
 - Run clean operating rhythms across Linear, Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, and Notion. Define how customer issues are weighed against new feature work, and who communicates when something breaks or ships.
 - Measure how well we execute using resolution time, escape rate, regression rate, and mean time to recovery (MTTR).
Planning & Launches
 - Facilitate quarterly planning, roadmap alignment, and cross-team dependencies.
 - Work with Product Marketing and GTM leadership to run launches and Early Access and beta programs, and make it clear to everyone at Onebrief what Product is working on, why it matters, and how it's going.
HOW YOU'LL OPERATE
 1. Discover, build, connect, communicate. Find what already exists and who to involve. Build the process or tool only if needed. Connect it to other teams and tools so it isn't a silo. Then record a walkthrough and share it.
 2. Build with AI. Design and maintain AI agents and automations for tasks like PRD drafting, release note checks, dashboard checks, and data grooming. Document custom builds in the ProdOps GitHub repo instead of building them ad hoc.
 3. Be the "PM of PMs." Reinforce simple, consistent practices so teams hit milestones and keep quality high.
 4. Turn signals into decisions. Make sure feedback and telemetry become roadmap and backlog changes.
 5. Work across the org. Partner closely with Engineering, Infra, Quality, InfraSec, Customer Relations, and Product Marketing. Be the one place the org can see release, reliability, and feedback status.
ABOUT YOU
You must have an active SECRET clearance or higher, and be willing to travel domestically or internationally when needed.
You mix good judgment with strong follow-through, and you balance user empathy with data. You care about building tools that work in real, time-sensitive situations. You are comfortable setting up structure when things are unclear, and you can hold your ground when a process needs to be enforced.
Core skills: process design, data analysis, technical program management, AI and automation, user research, cross-functional leadership
QUALIFICATIONS
REQUIRED
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
 - 3+ years in product operations, product management, technical program management, or release management in B2B/SaaS
 - Active SECRET clearance or higher
 - A track record of building 0→1 processes and scaling them
 - Strong data skills: you can pull, analyze, and present data (SQL or similar, dashboards, product analytics)
 - Hands-on AI experience: you have built or used prompts, agents, and automations to improve real workflows
 - Working knowledge of release practices: feature flags, staged rollouts, rollback, and release notes
 - Experience with bug tracking and triage, including severity levels and resolution targets
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence, Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Notion, or similar tools
 - Experience running launches, early access or beta programs, and customer feedback loops
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including recorded walkthroughs and documentation
Preferred
 - Military, government, or national security experience
 - Familiarity with STIGs, POA&Ms, ATO, and secure or air-gapped deployments
 - Experience with product telemetry, observability, or quality-of-service measures
 - Experience with MCP, API integrations, or scripting to automate workflows
 - Experience with tool migrations (for example, moving to Atlassian) while keeping processes intact
 - Experience working with multiple teams to set one standard process
Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
THE ROLE
You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 - Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.
 - Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.
 - Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.
 - Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.
 - Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.
 - Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.
 - Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR  
 - Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.
 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.
 - Comfortable working across different business functions.
 - Strong ownership and execution skills.
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 - Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
 - Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR
 - People who only want to attend meetings.  
 - Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.  
 - Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.  
 - People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.  
 - People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions
LOCATION 
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in United States. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in United States.
LANGUAGE
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
INTERVIEW PROCESS:
Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task 
 2. Role-specific interview 
 3. CEO / final round 
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. 
Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Enterprise Technology
jobs.description:
At Diverge Health we are passionate about improving health access and outcomes for those most in need. We partner with primary care providers to improve the engagement and management of their Medicaid patients, offering independent practices with specialized resources and clinical programs to close gaps in care. Our teams work to address medical, social and behavioral patient needs, lowering healthcare costs and improving patient lives. Guided by our core values of humility, continuous learning and feeling the weight, our team is on a mission to strengthen communities from within, unlocking people's ability to live their healthiest lives.   
 We are looking for a Project Manager, Enterprise Technology to join our team! This is a high-profile role for someone who can keep many moving pieces organized, speak the language of technology teams, and tell leaders the truth about where projects stand. The role sits in Enterprise Technology and Security and reports to the Director of Enterprise Technology and Security.   
 What you'll do   
 As the Project Manager, Enterprise Technology, you will play a pivotal role in planning, coordinating, and delivering our most visible technology projects. That starts with major migrations tied to our integration with Medical Home Network, and as those wrap up, more enterprise technology work will follow. This is a long-term need, and the project list keeps growing.   
 Key areas you'll add value   
 Get oriented quickly on active projects, workstream owners, and stakeholders so you can start driving delivery without slowing the teams already in motion.   
 Build and maintain detailed project plans with clear owners, milestones, and dependencies, keeping them current as priorities shift so everyone works from the same picture.   
 Run the operating cadence by tracking status, leading working sessions, and surfacing risks and blockers early, driving decisions to closure before they stall the work.   
 Own delivery on technically complex work, including Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Resources Information System (HRIS), and Active Directory migrations, systems consolidation, and data and platform migrations.   
 Translate between technical teams and business partners so tradeoffs are clear and nothing stalls in handoff.   
 Give leadership honest, timely updates, including when a project is behind or at risk, so decisions are made with the full picture.   
 Deliver clear, executive-ready materials for steering committee and leadership reviews that reduce the burden on leaders rather than adding to it.   
 What you'll bring   
 3 to 5+ years of project management experience in a technology environment.   
 Comfort with technical conversations, including enough fluency to follow what is being discussed in the room, even though you will not be doing the technical work.   
 Ability to manage multiple projects in parallel without dropping details.   
 Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project and Smartsheet.   
 PMP certification preferred, and Agile certification a plus.   
 Ability to stay steady under pressure on high-visibility work.   
 Preferred experience   
 Experience with ERP, HRIS, or identity and directory migrations.   
 Healthcare or health tech experience.   
 Experience supporting mergers or integrations.   
 Comfort with complexity, interdependencies, and incomplete information.   
 Who we're looking for   
 Flexible and quick to adapt when priorities change.   
 Detail oriented and organized, with a steady hand on the small things that keep big projects on track.   
 Skilled at explaining technical topics in plain language.   
 Someone who takes a project and runs with it, and asks for input when it counts.   
 Willing to speak up, sharing your reasoning clearly and respectfully if you think a decision is a bad idea, and staying engaged and committed when leaders go a different direction.   
 A person who earns trust through follow-through.   
 Able to bring people through change with empathy and clarity.   
 A strong representative of Diverge Health's mission, vision, and values in every interaction and every deliverable.   
 This is a full-time, exempt, salaried position. Commensurate on candidate experience, the expected base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $140,000. 
 Our Investors 
 Diverge Health is funded by GV and incubated by Triple Aim Partners , which since 2019 has partnered with entrepreneurs to co-found and launch eight companies focused on improving the quality, experience and total cost of healthcare. 
 At Diverge Health we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and enable us to realize our mission. If you do not have experience in all areas detailed above, we encourage you to share your unique background with us and how it might be additive to our team. 
 Special Considerations  
 Diverge Health is dedicated to the principles of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Employment Opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, reproductive health decisions, family responsibilities or any other characteristic protected by the federal, state or local laws. Our decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs. 
  At this time, we are unable to support hiring in Alaska and Hawaii due to our primary operations being based in the Eastern and Central time zones . 
 Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future . 
 Fraud Notice 
 To protect you from recruitment scams: legitimate communication from Diverge Health will only come from @greenhouse.com, @divergehealth.org, @divergecares.com, or  no-reply@us.greenhouse-mail.io . If you receive outreach from any other domain claiming to represent us, please don't engage, and consider reporting it.

 Guidepoint’s Client Service team connects leading investment firms, consultancies, and corporations with the subject-matter experts they need to make informed business and investment decisions. By understanding each client’s specific research needs and delivering targeted expert matches, often within hours, the team plays a critical role in providing a fast, high-quality client experience. 
 As an Associate Project Manager on the Client Service team, you will manage client projects, lead execution, and work directly with a team of Associates to deliver the right expert matches for each request. This is a dynamic role that may initially emphasize expert recruiting, project execution, or a combination of both. As responsibilities grow, the role is designed to expand into broader ownership of client relationships and project delivery. Due to the collaborative nature of the Client Service team, the work schedule is hybrid with three days in the office required. 
 This is a Hybrid role from our NYC office. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Manage day-to-day client project execution and drive delivery across live project requests, ensuring a fast, high-quality client experience 
 Run several client requests at once, navigating shifting priorities, evolving project needs, and tight deadlines while maintaining strong execution 
 Provide feedback to and work directly with Associates, elevating performance through guidance on sourcing, outreach, vetting, and screening best practices 
 Build tailored sourcing strategies and execute targeted research, recruiting, and outreach to identify and qualify the right experts for each client request 
 Partner with Business Development and Relationship Management leaders to deepen client engagement, expand use of Guidepoint’s services, and build toward broader account ownership over time 
 Experience You Will Bring: 
 Bachelor’s degree, with strong academic track record 
 Preferred minimum of 1 year of relevant experience 
 AI fluency and experience using AI-enabled tools to support research, organization, prioritization, and written communication 
 Ability to use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully and responsibly, with attention to accuracy, confidentiality, data quality, and human judgment 
 Curiosity about emerging technology and a willingness to continue building skills with new tools that improve productivity and client service 
 Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa sponsorship. Guidepoint does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this role 
 Successful Associate Project Managers:  
 Communicate confidently and professionally with clients, experts, and internal stakeholders at all levels 
 Manage competing priorities and tight deadlines with strong judgment, organization, and sense of urgency 
 Bring strong attention to detail and the ability to navigate complex client requests, communication across multiple stakeholders, and scheduling logistics with accuracy 
 Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt quickly to evolving client needs 
 Write clearly and concisely, organize high volumes of information effectively, and deliver a high standard of client service in high-pressure situations 
 Work effectively both independently and collaboratively as part of a team 
 What We Offer: 
 The annual base salary for this position is $80,000. In addition, this role is eligible for monthly performance-based compensation tied to project execution along with a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of specific metrics. High-performing Associate Project Managers can earn $1,000 or more per month in additional compensation.   
 You will also be eligible for the following benefits: 
 15 days of PTO, 10 paid holidays, and sick leave

We partner with clients to deliver scalable cloud technology solutions that align business needs, technical architecture, and long-term growth. Our teams bring together Salesforce expertise, delivery discipline, and a collaborative approach to help clients move from vision to execution. 
 Summary 
 FormativGroup is seeking an experienced Salesforce Project Manager to lead complex Salesforce implementation and transformation initiatives across enterprise client environments. This role is responsible for managing the full project lifecycle, including scope, timeline, resources, budget, deliverables, risk management, stakeholder communications, and escalations, while consistently driving successful client outcomes and delivery excellence. 
 The ideal candidate will bring a strong blend of project leadership, Salesforce delivery expertise, Agile program management, and client-facing consulting experience. This individual will partner closely with executive stakeholders, architects, developers, analysts, QA teams, and cross-functional delivery resources to successfully execute enterprise-scale Salesforce initiatives. 
 This role requires a consultative leader who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, manage multi-workstream programs, and ensure high-quality delivery across Salesforce ecosystems including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Lightning Platform, and related enterprise integrations. 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end Salesforce implementation projects across the full SDLC and Agile delivery lifecycle. 
 Manage project scope, schedule, financials, risks, dependencies, deliverables, resource planning, and client expectations throughout the engagement lifecycle. 
 Drive successful delivery of complex multi-cloud and multi-integration Salesforce initiatives involving cross-functional and distributed teams. 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, facilitating executive-level communications, status reporting, workshops, governance meetings, and delivery reviews. 
 Collaborate closely with solution architects, business analysts, developers, QA teams, and leadership to align technical and functional delivery strategies. 
 Monitor project health through KPIs, financial tracking, RAID logs, sprint metrics, and delivery milestones while proactively mitigating risks and resolving escalations. 
 Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, retrospectives, and release planning. 
 Ensure adherence to Salesforce implementation best practices, governance standards, quality expectations, and delivery methodologies. 
 Support solutioning activities including requirements gathering, estimation, roadmap planning, implementation strategy, and change management. 
 Participate in pre-sales and business development activities including scoping workshops, statement of work reviews, effort estimation, and client presentations. 
 Provide leadership and mentorship to delivery teams, including offshore and remote resources, while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 Coordinate deployment readiness, testing activities, UAT support, release management, and production cutover planning. 
 Maintain strong client relationships while positioning FormativGroup as a trusted advisor and strategic delivery partner. 
 Qualifications 
 Minimum 5+ years of experience managing enterprise Salesforce implementation projects within consulting or professional services environments. 
 Strong experience delivering solutions across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Lightning Platform, and related Salesforce technologies. 
 8+ years of experience leading Agile software delivery initiatives across project, product, or program management disciplines. 
 Active PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is nice to have.  
 Demonstrated success managing large-scale, multi-workstream, multi-cloud Salesforce programs with complex integration landscapes. 
 Experience leading geographically distributed delivery teams, including offshore/onshore delivery models. 
 Strong understanding of Salesforce delivery methodologies, release management, SDLC processes, and Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, and XP. 
 Experience managing project financials including forecasting, budgeting, utilization tracking, and delivery performance metrics. 
 Proven ability to manage executive stakeholders, facilitate difficult conversations, and drive alignment across technical and business teams. 
 Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand Salesforce architecture, integrations, APIs, data migration strategies, and platform capabilities. 
 Experience working in complex or regulated enterprise environments with an understanding of governance, compliance, and security considerations. 
 Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and client relationship management skills. 
 Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced consulting environments while managing multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously. 
 Preferred Qualifications

 Advanced Administrator 
 Platform App Builder

 Service Cloud Consultant 
 Experience Cloud Consultant 
 Salesforce Certified Application Architect 
 Scrum Master certification such as CSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent. 
 Familiarity with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Salesforce deployment frameworks.

jobs.description:
