Location: New York City (3 days on-site)
ABOUT LAWHIVE
Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.
We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. Our specialized AI agent for legal work, Lawrence, works alongside lawyers, putting human legal judgment right where it belongs: at the center of every matter.
We’re backed by a $60M Series B at a $685M valuation, from investors including Google Ventures, TQ Ventures, Mitch Rales, Balderton Capital and Premier League footballers Harry Maguire and Reece James. In the last few years we’ve hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we’re on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.
So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.
THE ROLE
We’re growing rapidly across the US by partnering with established law firms and transforming how they operate.
Through Lawhive MSO, we partner with established law firms to provide the operational support they need to run their businesses. Back-office employees at these firms are employed through Lawhive MSO’s PEO partnership with TriNet. They need responsive, reliable People support during US business hours, from someone who understands their needs and can help resolve issues quickly.
As our Operations Associate, you’ll be the main point of contact for employees across Lawhive MSO’s partner firms, taking ownership of the day-to-day administration of the TriNet relationship. You’ll handle queries relating to payroll, benefits, onboarding, leave, and other employment matters, working directly with TriNet to ensure employees receive the support they need. You’ll also support the onboarding of new partner firms, making sure employees are set up correctly and transitions run smoothly.
You’ll be working closely with our MSO, Finance and Ops team in New York as well as our People team in London. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an important part of our US operations and help build the processes that support Lawhive MSO as it grows.
WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
 - You’ll keep our partner firms running smoothly. Act as the main point of contact between employees at our partner firms and our PEO provider, Trinet, helping resolve questions and issues related to payroll, benefits, and HR administration.
 - Supporting employees through key moments: Guide employees through key moments like joining Lawhive, enrolling in benefits, and navigating changes to their employment, making the process as simple and seamless as possible.
 - You’ll be at the center of firm transitions. Support the HR and administrative side of bringing new partner firms onto our PEO arrangement, ensuring employees are set up correctly and the transition runs smoothly.
 - You’ll build, not just maintain. You’ll create the processes and use AI and automation to make each new firm onboarding faster and simpler than the last, and grow with the role as the network expands.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
 - 1+ years in an operations role in a high-growth environment. Ideally with hands-on experience in HR administration and benefits enrollment.
 - Experience working with a PEO or HR platform. You’ve used providers like TriNet, Justworks, Rippling, Insperity or ADP TotalSource, and know how to get things done with them.
 - Sharp attention to detail. Comfortable managing payroll processes, employee records, and benefits enrollment, with a high level of accuracy.
 - Clear, calm communication. You’re confident working with employees, managers and external providers, and people trust you to handle their questions.
 - A bias to action. You pick things up quickly, take ownership and figure things out without waiting to be told.
 - Discretion. You handle confidential employee information with care and good judgment.
 - An AI-native mindset. You’re excited to use AI tools to cut manual work and move faster.
BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE
 - Working knowledge of US employment basics across multiple states (leave, wage and hour, benefits eligibility).
 - Experience supporting integrations, transitions or a fast-scaling business.
 - Experience in a law firm, professional services or MSO environment.

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team. We’re not yet where we want to be but as we scale we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

 That work lives in Marketo, and we are looking for someone to own it. You will build the campaigns, nurtures, and programs that go out the door, keep the database and the Salesforce integration in good shape, and make sure what we send can actually be measured afterward. It suits someone who enjoys being inside the tooling and is bothered when a record ends up in the wrong place.
 Our marketing stack is Marketo, Marketo Measure, and Salesforce, with Looker for reporting. AI is part of how this team works day to day, and we want someone who already works that way.
 Key  R esponsibilities 
 Build and QA email programs, nurtures, forms, and campaign programs in Marketo end to end
 Own Marketo administration: program architecture, smart campaigns, operational programs, templates, and forms

 Monitor and resolve sync issues between Marketo and Salesforce, and own Salesforce campaign setup for marketing programs
 Help implement and maintain our lead scoring and lifecycle logic across both systems

 Support our attribution and Marketo Measure work

jobs.title: Utilities Infrastructure Project Manager (Water)
jobs.description:
Project Planning & Delivery
 Own a portfolio of water projects from scope definition through closeout, finishing each on budget and on schedule, with no projects past due.
 Define scope fully before bidding, including what's in and out, so contractors price and plan the real work and change requests are rare.
 Build the plan up front: lead times, agency review times, access and seasonal constraints, and potential start delays. Start early enough to finish on time.
 Maintain project plans, milestones, and budgeted completion dates in project management software; flag risks early and recover projects that fall behind.
 Visit project sites as needed, and verify that work is actually complete and ready before marking a project complete.
Contractor & Engineer Management
 Manage engineers and contractors to completion on every assigned project, holding them accountable for quality, safety, schedule, and cost.
 Walk contractors through the scope and schedule before they start and confirm their understanding in writing; manage bids, contracts, and change orders; and compare change requests against the survey, scope, and drawings before approving.
 Engage engineers for design and construction on critical projects and other projects that require engineering; define their scopes of work, review designs and cost estimates, and review invoices and progress reports.
 Select and develop a reliable bench of contractors in the assigned region and replace those who do not perform, with documented reasons.
Permitting & Regulatory Coordination
 Coordinate water project permits, plan reviews, and approvals with state agencies and local authorities, in partnership with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager.
 Build agency review time into every plan, respond quickly to agency comments, and confirm approvals and conditions are cleared before work starts.
 Ensure projects are built and documented to meet regulatory requirements, and hand off completed systems and documentation to the Sr. Utilities Program Manager for ongoing compliance.
Budget, Cost Control & Reporting
 Develop project budgets and cost forecasts; track actual costs against the budget and report variances early.
 Report project status, past-due projects, risks, and needed decisions to the VP of Capital Projects and the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on an agreed cadence.
 Support annual utility budget planning with project scopes and cost estimates.
Collaboration & Business Partnership
 Keep community managers and RVPs informed about schedules, access, and anything that affects their communities, serving as a single point of contact so they don't have to field calls from multiple parties.
 Partner with the Sr. Utilities Program Manager on project priorities, sequencing, and capital needs identified through system health and compliance findings.
 Stay on the shared outage communication thread and assist as needed; the Sr. Utilities Program Manager leads utility emergency response.
 Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and care consistent with Havenpark’s purpose of creating caring communities.
Qualifications
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental science, or a related field preferred.
 Experience: 3-5 years managing utility infrastructure projects, specifically water.
 Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred, not required.
 Skills & Knowledge: 
 Water treatment, storage, distribution, and irrigation project delivery, from design through construction and closeout
 Drinking water regulations, agency plan review, and permitting
 Construction contracts, bidding, change orders, and vendor management
 Project budgeting, forecasting, and cost tracking
 Project management software and scheduling tools
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Self-motivated, organized problem solver able to manage multiple projects and priorities independently
 High learning agility; works well with all levels of the organization and is a strong team player
 Physical Demands & Additional Requirements 
 Primarily an office-based position with typical physical demands related to extended computer and phone use, including long periods of sitting, and periods of walking and standing at project sites in outdoor conditions. Travel is expected about once per quarter to visit large projects, with occasional additional travel for meetings.
 Able to pass a criminal background check.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Permitting [New Jersey]
jobs.description:
About Pulley
Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects. 
Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.
We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.
Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.
The Role
You must be located in New Jersey to be considered for this role. 
Our in-house permitting team is a key function for driving fast, reliable permitting outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will:
 - Support our lead project managers in delivering great permitting outcomes for customers
 - Help conduct permit research with a high degree of accuracy
 - Assist in preparing permit plans
 - Collaborate with city staff on nuances and ambiguities
 - Monitor permit status and ensure timely responses
 - Provide feedback to product & engineering teams to help refine our software platform
 - Work with permitting leadership to refine our standard operating procedures
Who You Are
To be successful in this role, you are likely someone with:
 - 3+ years in either construction management or architecture, with a focus on project management
 - Experience applying for and obtaining construction permits
 - Ability to research permit requirements with accuracy
 - Comfortable interfacing city staff and navigating administrative processes
 - Clear communicator with a strong attention to detail
 - Proactive problem solver

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION
ButterflyMX is on a mission to empower people to automate property access, operations, and security from a single platform. Our products are installed in more than 20,000+ multifamily, commercial, gated communities, and student-housing properties worldwide, including properties developed, owned, and managed by the most trusted names in real estate. Our features are designed for developers, owners, property managers, and tenants and our products lower operating costs and improve tenant satisfaction.
OUR SOLUTION 
Developers and owners no longer need to run building wiring or install in-unit hardware. Property managers can grant building access, revoke permissions, and review entry logs from an online dashboard. Residents can open doors from their smartphones, issue visitor access, and see who is trying to enter the building.
OUR CULTURE & VALUES
Fantastic people are the key to our success. As a distributed, primarily remote workforce, we’re looking for more intelligent, passionate, collaborative, ai-forward, and down-to-earth individuals to join our growing team. We’re driven by a shared commitment to excellence and innovation, grounded in our core values: We delight our customers, We take ownership, We are a community of collaborators, We speak up, We think big and do small, and We are tenacious.
ROLE OVERVIEW
ButterflyMX is seeking a Client Onboarding Specialist to help new and existing clients successfully onboard, understand, and use our products. This client-facing role combines thoughtful communication, strong organization, and technical aptitude to create a smooth onboarding experience.
You will work directly with clients to coordinate onboarding activities, provide training, support product setup and integrations, and address questions along the way. You will partner across internal teams to keep work moving, maintain visibility into open requests, and help clients feel confident using ButterflyMX.
Success in this role requires ownership, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. You will manage multiple priorities, solve problems as they arise, and help improve the processes and resources that make client onboarding more effective as we scale.
RESPONSIBILITIES
 - Guide new and existing clients through onboarding by communicating key steps, setting clear expectations, and helping teams understand how to use ButterflyMX solutions through email, phone, and video support.
 - Simultaneously onboard multiple projects and clients, maintaining clear communication and timely follow-through.
 - Provide initial and refresher training on ButterflyMX products, administrative tools, and relevant features.
 - Support clients through product setup, integrations, troubleshooting, onboarding challenges, and engaging internal teams when needed.
 - Maintain accurate records, ticket updates, and onboarding documentation to ensure work is visible and actionable.
 - Work collaboratively with Client Success, Technical Support, Implementation, and other internal teams to drive client outcomes and ensure continuity in the client experience.
 - Identify and provide feedback on recurring questions, onboarding friction, and opportunities to improve client education, processes, and resources.
REQUIREMENTS
 - 2+ years of experience in client onboarding, client support, customer service, or a similar client-facing role, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.
 - Experience using Zendesk or another ticketing platform to manage client requests, document interactions, and track resolutions.
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
 - Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
 - Strong problem-solving skills and technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn new products, systems, and integrations.
 - A proactive, ownership-oriented approach with reliable follow-through and sound judgment.
 - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and client stakeholders.
 - Maintain a professional, client-focused presence by keeping your camera on during scheduled video calls with clients, fostering engagement, building rapport, and delivering an exceptional onboarding experience.
 - Knowledge of property management, proptech, or hardware-enabled SaaS is a plus.
 - Proven experience with leveraging AI tools in both professional and personal settings.
 - ButterflyMX is an AI-forward organization, and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in every role.
COMPENSATION
The expected base salary range for this position is $30-35/hr. Actual compensation will depend on factors including budget, skills, experience, location, and internal equity. This position may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other forms of compensation, where applicable.
BENEFITS
 - Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans (ButterflyMX covers 80% of the cost) starting day 1
 - 401(k) plan with a match
 - 10 paid holidays, 20 vacation days, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays
 - Basic Life and Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
 - Short and Long Term Disability (ButterflyMX covers 100% of the cost)
 - Paid Family Leave
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Quarterly self-care stipends
 - Access to optional benefits including pre-tax flexible healthcare spending accounts (FSA and HSA), Dependent Care FSA, and Commuter Benefits, as well as optional Supplemental Life, AD&D, Hospital Indemnity, Legal, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet, and Personal Liability Insurance
 - And more!
ButterflyMX is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. You must have the authorization to work in the US to become an employee. We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates and employees. If you need reasonable accommodations during the application or the recruiting process, please let our recruiting team know.

jobs.title: Project Manager, High-Voltage
jobs.description:
Clēnera is a tier-one developer and independent power producer located in Boise, Idaho, and is the U.S. subsidiary of Enlight Renewable Energy (Nasdaq: ENLT ). We develop, finance, construct, own, and operate utility-scale solar and energy storage facilities throughout the United States. In its 2025 analysis of solar independent power producers, S&P Global ranked Clēnera as a top ten U.S. owner of planned installations in the next five years. Clēnera has over 1.9 GW of solar and 5.1 GWh of storage in operations or construction, and a development pipeline totaling 17.8 GW of solar and 51.1 GWh of storage across 23 states. Our company culture is at the core of everything we do, so you’ll regularly find Caring, Committed, and Courageous individuals who value respectful, cross-functional collaboration with partners internally and externally. With our tremendous portfolio growth, we are increasing our headcount to meet the demands of the business. Are you ready to change the world with us? 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 The HV Project Manager represents the Owner (IPP) and leads all high-voltage (HV), protection & controls (P&C), SCADA/communications, testing, and commissioning activities for utility-scale solar  and energy storage assets. You will own cost, schedule, scope, quality, and risk for the HV build and commissioning phases from pre-functional checks through energization, interconnection testing, COD, and turnover to Operations. The PM functions as the primary interface with utilities, Owner’s Engineers, EPCs, testing/commissioning vendors, and internal stakeholders, ensuring systems are safe, compliant, utility-approved, and reliable for long-term operations.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Own end-to-end HV and site wide commissioning project planning and control, establishing the WBS, baseline schedule, cash flow forecasts, procurement milestones, and resource plans.
 Drive weekly schedule reviews, recovery planning, and critical path management with EPC and site leadership.
 Lead HV and site wide commissioning cost management and forecasting, including monthly EAC/EVA updates, change order pricing validation, contingency management, pay application review/approval, and alignment of financial reporting with Project Controls and Finance.
 Direct contract administration, ensuring scope clarity, deliverable compliance, and change management discipline; draft, negotiate, and recommend change orders and claims with clear schedule/cost impact analyses.

About Nava 
 Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
 As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.
 Position summary  
 You’ll manage the support of a mid-large scale product, working closely with our engineers, designers and government partners to triage issues and distill them into clear, actionable tickets for the team. You'll be available to tackle Priority one issues as they arise. You'll also work with the team to continually improve on our response and support of the system and build close working relationships with a variety of people, including engineers, client stakeholders, and partner vendors. 
 You think holistically and understand how the details of the project fit into the bigger picture, and take pride in working through highly ambiguous situations to deliver value to users. You have a strong bias towards action when faced with incomplete information, and communicate transparently to build consensus internally and externally.
 What you'll do
 Work directly at the intersection of government and the Nava team to manage our sprint process, estimate our efforts, triage incidents, manage expectations, and track and communicate progress as well as remove blockers when needed
 Proactively build relationships with stakeholders and other contractors
 Understand the team’s objectives, systems, and capabilities in order to make decisions about project priorities and to help resolve issues
 Coordinate multiple contractor teams to bring alignment to large ecosystems and create holistic success for everyone
 Accurately report risks, successes, progress, and failures
 Manage the team’s velocity and continually improve our processes for organizing ourselves and our work
 Demonstrate a passion for learning, embrace change, and ask insightful questions particularly about business needs and IT capabilities

 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, or Product Manager in a complex software development environment with multiple stakeholders
 Experience with both the use and management of ticketing systems. Jira and Confluence are used on this project so experience with them specifically is ideal, but it's more important that you’re diligent at tracking down issues and documenting them clearly
 Ability to demonstrate experience leading projects with significant complexity, including managing milestones, dependencies, and integrations with significant risk, uncertainty or scale
 Experience working with product, design, and engineering teams as a cohesive unit and maintaining open lines of communication in a multi-disciplinary environment 
 Experience using agile frameworks like scrum, kanban, or SAFe and familiarity with agile development practices such as continuous integration and continuous delivery
 Ability to grow and nurture existing and new client relationships to help drive prioritization across multiple projects and create ecosystems of success
 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
 Ability to communicate clearly and increase transparency, with a strong competency in situational awareness and conflict resolution
 An adaptive, proactive, empathetic, tenacious, and positive mind
 Desired skills
 Project management in a government context (state or federal)
 Experience working on iterative projects using prototypes, product pilots, and user research 
 Track record of introducing and expanding agile transformation and pursuing best practices in project management with clients and stakeholders 
 Experience launching new production systems with high public visibility in a fast-changing regulatory environment
 Experience working with development teams building APIs
   This role is pending contract award.  
 Compensation
 $114,300 — $127,000 USD

 Legal authorization to work in the United States
 Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
 Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

jobs.title: Project Manager, Iberia (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT NUMA
 Hey there! We’re Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
 We’re not just transforming the guest experience—we’re revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences.
 At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. We’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every voice is valued, and different perspectives fuel our innovation. 
 As a Project Manager at Numa, you will own the delivery of property launches with a main focus on Lisbon and Porto. Projects in Spain, other parts of Portugal and potentially other regions may also come up. You will manage 4 or more launches per year with a Launch Manager. You are responsible for delivering projects on time, on budget, and on brand—ensuring every space meets our design, tech, and operational standards. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams across all workstreams (base build, FF&E, OS&E, ICT, signage, and launch readiness), acting as the central point of accountability from technical due diligence through to signing to handover and to launch.
 Projects are new developments or takeovers, depending on the annual pipeline. Most are landlord-delivered: the landlord designs, tenders and builds, and you oversee delivery against lease requirements, budget and timeline, and flag risks early. You won't produce designs. The landlord's team designs and builds, and you review and steer. You support senior leadership decisions with clear recommendations, watch quality, architecture and the base build, and act as a control point so that Numa's procedures, standards and milestones are followed.
 You work in a project team, own your projects end-to-end and are expected to be autonomous within about 6 months. Travel is around 50%, mainly across Iberia, and you may be asked to travel to other cities or countries when needed.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Due Diligence & Pre-Contract Phase 
 Carry out technical due diligence with the project team, through to a go/no-go recommendation
 Evaluate technical feasibility of new properties (conversions, refurbishments, or developments) and review architectural, MEP, fire safety and ICT plans
 Estimate budgets, timelines, and risk profiles for each project
 Participate in lease and vendor contract reviews to ensure alignment with delivery objectives, focusing on technical and delivery clauses
 Work with legal and revenue in pre-signing to reach a signing decision
 2. Project Planning & Execution 
 Lead full-cycle project delivery, managing external partners (developers, landlords, general contractors, vendors)
 Act as the main contact for landlords and their consultants and contractors, including escalations
 Drive internal coordination across design, procurement, ops, revenue, legal, and tech teams
 Own project scheduling and scope control using standardised PM tools (Asana, G-Suite, etc.)
 Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks, scope changes, or cross-team conflicts proactively
 Track financials including CAPEX budgets, change orders, and payment approvals
 Ensure alignment with lease obligations and commercial handover terms
 Conduct regular site visits, quality control checks, and ensure Numa standards are fully implemented
 Navigate local permit and municipal processes, mainly in Lisbon and Porto, including heritage approvals, and work with the local contractor market
 3. Handover (HO) & Launch Management 
 Develop detailed launch plans including go-live strategy, timelines, and operational ramp-up
 Lead the HO process, a key part of the PM role, from technical acceptance through to launch and post-launch hypercare, in partnership with our Launch Manager
 Coordinate final delivery and installation of FF&E, OS&E, signage, and other assets
 Oversee snagging, quality assurance, and operational handover
 Ensure all departments are aligned and ready for opening day (ops, finance, revenue, legal, tech)
 4. Post-Launch & Continuous Improvement 
 Lead post-mortem reviews and capture lessons learned to improve future launches
 Work closely with procurement and design to reduce time and cost across the project lifecycle
 Your Profile 
 Architecture or civil engineering background (or equivalent proven experience) and at least 5 years on development or construction projects, with built projects and on-site follow-up you can demonstrate. 
 Strong technical background and understanding of architectural and MEP systems
 Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects across multiple sites. Has led technical due diligence
 Ability to read and assess contracts (leases, vendor agreements) in the pre-signing stage, and to work effectively with other teams such as legal, real estate and revenue
 Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day work, and interested in testing and helping implement new tools
 Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, including external vendors and landlords
 Comfortable managing multiple projects in parallel under time and budget constraints
 Fluency in Portuguese and advanced English is a must. Fluency in Spanish is a big plus but not a must-have.
 ABOUT OUR OFFER
 Empower your career: Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas help shape our future. Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and build a fulfilling career path. 
 Experience our brand: Immerse yourself in the Numa lifestyle with a complimentary stay. Share the love with friends and family through exclusive discounts on our stylish apartments. Connect with a global community of colleagues at our inspiring team-building events. 
 Numa values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at our company means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognised, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilise each person’s talents and strengths. We therefore welcome applications from people of all races, ethnicities, disability statuses, ages, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASIS
Basis https://www.basis.ai is a nonprofit applied AI research organization with two mutually reinforcing goals.
The first is to understand and build intelligence. This means to establish the mathematical principles of what it means to reason, to learn, to make decisions, to understand, and to explain; and to construct software that implements these principles.
The second is to advance society’s ability to solve intractable problems. This means expanding the scale, complexity, and breadth of problems that we can solve today, and even more importantly, accelerating our ability to solve problems in the future.
To achieve these goals, we’re building both a new technological foundation that draws inspiration from how humans reason, and a new kind of collaborative organization that puts human values first.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The objective of this role is to turn interest in Basis into signed, funded partnerships: more of them, closed faster, with nothing lost along the way.
Basis works with partners, customers, funders and investors on research collaborations, pilots and longer-term contracts. The founders and project leads own those relationships. The Business Operations Associate has three primary responsibilities:
 - Operate the deal pipeline. Keep every partnership, contract, gift and investor conversation in one CRM, each with an owner and a next step. Schedule the meetings, send the follow-ups, take contracts from first draft to signature, and prepare the weekly review of where things stand and what needs a decision.
 - Scale Basis's business opportunities. Start more of the right conversations, sooner: research prospective partners and funders, keep inbound interest warm, and prepare the founders for events and introductions.
 - Scale the business operations infrastructure. Build the CRM, templates, automations and reporting that let a small team handle many deals, using AI tools wherever they help.
Each deal will have one person responsible for what happens next, and often that person will be you. It is an early point in the life of Basis, and the systems you set up now will be the ones we scale with.
WE EXPECT YOU TO:
 - Finish what you start. Nothing you own goes quiet, and nobody has to remind you.
 - Have a record of noticing what needed doing, or a better way to do it, and doing it without being asked. We will ask for examples.
 - Keep records accurate. You have run a CRM or similar tool (HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce or equivalent) and kept it correct for the people who depend on it. A missed follow-up or a wrong number in a contract is a real problem, and you treat it as one.
 - Write clearly and quickly: follow-up emails, meeting notes, short briefings.
 - Keep commercial, funder and investor information confidential.
 - Be comfortable among researchers and engineers. You do not need to be a scientist, but you should be curious about the work.
In addition, the following would be an advantage:
 - Business operations, deal desk, sales operations or partnerships experience at a startup, research institute or deep-tech company.
 - Experience with both commercial deals and philanthropic or investor relationships.
 - Small automations you have built around a CRM, contract flow or inbox.
ROLE DETAILS
 - FT/PT: Part-time or contract preferred, about 20 hours per week; open to full-time.
 - In-person Policy: In the New York office at least two days a week; four days a week if full-time.
 - Location: New York City.
 - Reports to: Head of business development.
 - Compensation: $50–$70 per hour, depending on experience. Full-time equivalent $100,000–$145,000.
 - Hiring process: A short practical task, a conversation with the hiring manager, then interviews with the people you would work with.
Not sure you meet every detail? Whether it's qualifications, work pattern, or location, exceptional candidates who don't check every box above are still encouraged to apply.
Non-Discrimination Notice
Basis Research Institute provides equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or genetics and prohibits discrimination based on all protected characteristics.
Privacy Notice
By submitting your application, you grant Basis permission to use your materials for both hiring evaluation and recruitment-related research and development purposes. Your information may be processed in different countries, including the US. You retain copyright while providing Basis a license to use these materials for the stated purposes.
Read our full Global Data Privacy Notice here https://www.basis.ai/join-us/privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Shared Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join House Rx as a Shared Services Project Manager, where you will play a pivotal role in enhancing access and affordability of specialty medications for patients. You’ll collaborate closely with specialty care clinics and our team to optimize the specialty pharmacy experience with a focus on implementation at new customer sites. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Primary leader of customer facing calls, accountable for the completion of implementation steps
 Implementation project management through customer calls, timely follow up, and use of project management tools
 Responsible for coordination with sales and program manager team to bring visibility to implementation progress and blockers
 Coordination with leadership to drive implementation process efficiencies for credentialing, IT workstream, and other implementation related activities
 Support for initiatives and related project work
 Additional Responsibilities: 
 Work with clinic teams to streamline processes and workflows in coordination with clinical operations team
 Manage any issues with patient prescription attainment, including tracking packages, troubleshooting carrier issues, and monitoring work queues as assigned. 
 Troubleshoot issues with claim processing, payment processing, equipment function (barcode scanners, label printers) and escalate to internal resources as appropriate 
 Triage support issues related to our PMS Platform for new and existing clinic partners
 Act as a liaison between the patient, provider and our operational team to effectively and efficiently resolve issues. Problems happen, you are responsible for delighting as you solve them. 
 Primary responsibility in at least one of the following areas and cross-training in at least one additional area:
 Credentialing - work closely with clinic partners at new and established practices to complete initial credentialing with PBMs, credentialing renewals, state regulatory agency registration (where required), and manage enrollment in EFT and ERA 
 Legal model - work closely with sales, program managers, and clinic partners to provide an accurate summary of state specific legal requirements for MID dispensing space, provider verification registration and requirements, practice dispensing registration and requirements, and pharmacy dispensing space requirements. 
 Accreditation - work closely with clinic partners to support initial and renewal accreditation with ACHC, URAC, and others. Support required program monitoring and auditing to maintain compliance with accreditation
 Project management - implementation project management through leading customer calls, timely follow up, use of project management tools. Responsible for coordination with sales and program manager team to bring visibility to implementation progress and blockers. 
 Drug ordering - support clinic partners through submission of wholesaler orders, monitor delivery, troubleshoot shortages and wholesaler catalog errors. Work closely with clinics to manage accurate inventory through training, monitoring and ongoing process improvements. Work closely with distribution leaders to manage customer-specific wholesaler account matrix to optimize customer spend. 
 Supply management - ensure clinic partners maintain adequate inventory, optimizing supply chain efficiency while reducing costs.
 Implementation IT workstream - work closely with implementation project manager to facilitate clinic partner IT workstream initiation, testing of EHR functionality (login, task groups, reporting, test eRx), and other IT related tasks (phone extension set up, VPN access, etc.) 
 About You 
 You are someone who loves to dig in and can think outside the box
 You are a creative problem solver interested in positively impacting each patient’s pharmacy experience
 Self-motivated with sense of urgency for quality resolution
 You have mastered all the core pharmacy technician skills, such as processing claims and dispensing medications, and are ready to expand your career
 You are comfortable engaging with patients, providers, and all members of the care team both in-person and over the phone
 You have experience navigating specialty medication benefits investigation, prior authorization, and financial assistance
 You are excited about working in a start-up environment and enjoy solving complex problems
 You are someone who looks for proactive solutions and can identify more efficient workflows.
 Why You Should Join Our Team 
 A career at House Rx offers the chance to work with a talented group of entrepreneurs, healthcare professionals, and technology builders who are passionate about improving specialty care and making it easier for patients to access the medication that they need.
 At House Rx, we strive to build and maintain an environment where employees from all backgrounds are valued, respected and have the opportunity to succeed. You'll find a culture that supports open communication, embracing failure as a learning opportunity, and always being open to new ideas—no matter how radical. We are a remote-first company, however some pharmacy operations roles require onsite clinic presence. We’re committed to creating a positive and collaborative culture to achieve our mission, all while supporting our team members in all aspects of their lives—at home, at work and everywhere in between. 
 In particular, we offer:
 Paid time off
 Generous parental leave 
 Comprehensive healthcare, vision and dental benefits
 Competitive salary and equity stake
 We’re backed by forward-thinking investors committed to transforming healthcare, including Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital, LRV Health, Khosla Ventures, Maverick Ventures, 1984.vc, and Character.

jobs.title: Care Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Color Health is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation’s first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color’s goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys.
Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply!
About the Role
As a Care Operations Associate at Color, you will play an essential role in supporting the day-to-day operations of our care delivery teams, helping ensure our clinicians and patient-facing staff have the tools, resources, and support they need to deliver high-quality care.
You’ll work closely with our Care Operations team across a wide range of functions, including clinician scheduling, licensure and credentialing, quality assurance, onboarding, reporting, and operational coordination. You’ll help keep critical processes running smoothly, troubleshoot challenges, and support the implementation of new workflows and initiatives.
This is a dynamic, hands-on role where no two days will look exactly alike. As Color continues to grow and evolve, so will your responsibilities. We’re looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and excited to learn. You’ll thrive if you enjoy solving problems, taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and finding ways to make healthcare operations more efficient and effective.
What You'll Own: 
 - Support daily care operations: Execute and coordinate day-to-day operational activities across our clinical and patient-facing teams, ensuring processes run smoothly, issues are resolved, and critical tasks are completed accurately and on time.
 - Coordinate scheduling and capacity: Maintain clinician schedules, coordinate availability and coverage changes, monitor scheduling gaps, and support workforce planning and capacity management.
 - Manage licensure and credentialing activities: Track professional licenses, certifications, and credentialing requirements; maintain accurate records; coordinate renewals; and support ongoing compliance monitoring.
 - Support team onboarding and offboarding: Coordinate operational onboarding activities, including system access, training schedules, credentialing, and documentation, to ensure a seamless experience for new and departing team members.
 - Assist with quality assurance and compliance: Conduct routine audits, maintain quality and compliance trackers, identify discrepancies, and escalate issues to ensure operational and clinical standards are consistently met.
 - Maintain operational data and reporting: Update trackers and dashboards, compile recurring reports, monitor key operational metrics, and help ensure data is accurate, organized, and actionable.
 - Support process improvements and new initiatives: Maintain SOPs and process documentation, assist with workflow changes and new program launches, and proactively identify opportunities to simplify, streamline, or automate manual processes.
 - Adapt to evolving operational priorities: Take on new responsibilities and projects as business needs change, working collaboratively across teams to solve problems and continuously improve how we operate.
What We're Looking For:
 - 1–3 years of experience in healthcare operations, clinical administration, or a related healthcare setting.
 - Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to manage operational processes where precision, timeliness, and compliance are essential.
 - Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize effectively, and consistently follow through.
 - A proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to independently troubleshoot problems, take ownership, and know when to escalate.
 - Strong adaptability and comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving responsibilities in a fast-paced startup environment.
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across clinical, operational, and cross-functional teams.
 - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn new systems, manage spreadsheets and operational tools, and embrace new technologies.
 - A genuine interest in healthcare operations, continuous improvement, and supporting teams that deliver high-quality patient care.
Nice to Have:
 - Experience with healthcare licensure, credentialing, compliance, or quality assurance processes.
 - Experience supporting clinician scheduling, workforce coordination, or healthcare staff onboarding.
 - Familiarity with healthcare operations platforms, electronic health records, or credentialing systems.
 - Experience in a digital health, telehealth, or startup environment.
 - Exposure to process improvement, workflow automation, or AI-powered tools.
What We Offer:
 - 💰 Competitive salary 
 - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
 - 📈 401k match 
 - 📝 Monthly phone and wifi stipend and an annual ergonomic stipend
 - 🏝 Generous vacation policy, paid holidays and company-wide recharge days
 - 🍼 Equal paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

Base compensation range: $75,000 - $90,000 per year

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
What is Coast 
 Coast is re-imagining the trillion-dollar U.S. B2B card payments infrastructure, with a focus on the country’s 500,000 commercial fleets, 40 million commercial vehicles, and many millions of commercial drivers. The incumbent technologies that cater to these customers are decades old, and businesses with fleets increasingly demand modern digital experiences and transparent financial services products. Coast’s mission is to deliver this at a transformational scale, beginning with the Coast Fleet and Fuel Card built on a cutting-edge spend management platform.
 About the Role 
 Coast’s biggest initiatives cross every team. You’ll own them: get the right people aligned, keep the work moving, and make sure it lands.
 As a Business Operations Associate, that someone is you. You’ll own and run cross-functional projects tied to Coast’s top priorities, from first scoping to final handoff. You’ll work with leaders across the company, so you’ll need to be credible with executives and just as comfortable in the details with the people doing the work.
 AI is a big part of how we do this. You’ll use it to plan faster, synthesize information, draft and analyze, and automate the repetitive parts of project work. You’ll also run projects that put AI to use across the business. You don’t need to be an engineer. You do need to be the person who reaches for AI first, and who can tell when it’s doing a good job and when it isn’t.
 This is a role for someone who gets energy from turning an ambiguous goal into a clear plan, getting a dozen people aligned, and shipping. You’ll be expected to act like an owner: you take responsibility for the outcome, not just your piece of it.
 It’s a generalist role with broad exposure to how a growth-stage fintech runs. Over time, you can build depth in an area you care about and take on bigger parts of the business as it scales.
 What You’ll Do 
 Own cross-functional projects end to end 
 Run company-level and cross-team initiatives from scoping through launch: define the goal, build the plan, line up owners, set milestones, and drive it to done.
 Keep projects moving across teams that don’t report to you. You get things unstuck by making the next step obvious and the tradeoffs clear.
 Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with a recommendation, and keep leaders informed without making them chase you.
 Close projects properly: document what shipped, what you learned, and what happens next.
 Be the connective tissue across the company 
 Work with Product, Sales, Finance, Risk, Legal, People, and Operations to make sure the right people are in the room and decisions get made.
 Translate between teams. Take a goal from an executive and break it into work others can act on, and take messy ground-level input and turn it into something leadership can decide on.
 Run the cadences that keep cross-functional work on track: kickoffs, standups, status updates, and retros.
 Support quarterly planning and goal tracking by turning priorities into projects with owners and dates.
 Help figure out what we should do next 
 Scope and evaluate new opportunities, such as a new process, partnership, or initiative, and bring leaders a clear recommendation backed by the numbers.
 Build the analyses and decision frameworks that help leadership prioritize and decide where to put time and money.
 Take ideas from “this could work” to a pilot, then to something the company runs.
 Use AI to move faster and to help the company use it 
 Use AI in your own project work: planning, synthesizing inputs from many teams, drafting, analysis, and status reporting. Build repeatable workflows and prompts that cut the manual work out of running a project.
 Run projects that bring AI into how Coast operates, from piloting a new tool to redesigning a process around automation, and measure whether it worked.
 Evaluate new AI tools against real problems and give a clear recommendation on what we should adopt and what we should skip.
 Share what works. Write it down and teach other teams.
 Bring data to the decisions 
 Define what success looks like for each project and track it with real numbers.
 Pull and analyze data to size problems, test assumptions, and measure results.
 Build simple, clear updates and dashboards that show leaders where a project stands.
 What Success Looks Like 
 By 30 days 
 You know the company’s current priorities, the key leaders, and how decisions get made.
 You’ve taken over one active project and the people on it know you’re the person to go to.
 By 90 days 
 You’ve run a cross-functional project from start to finish, and the teams involved would work with you again.
 Leaders get clear, regular project updates from you and don’t need to ask where things stand.
 You’ve used AI to take real time out of how you run projects, and you can show how.
 By 6 months 
 You’re running multiple projects at once without things slipping.
 You’ve led at least one project that put AI to work in the business, with a measured result.
 Executives trust you with high-priority, high-visibility work.
 Teams use the project templates, cadences, and playbooks you built.
 Requirements 
 2-4 years in business operations, project or program management, strategy and operations, consulting, or a similar role. Fintech, SaaS, or financial services is preferred.
 Proven track record of running cross-functional projects with many stakeholders and shipping them on time.
 AI-native mindset: you already use AI tools in your daily work, you’ve built something with them (a workflow, an automation, an agent, a prompt library), and you’re excited to push further.
 Strong structured thinking: you can take an ambiguous problem and turn it into a clear plan.
 Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an executive in two minutes and write the doc that gets a team aligned.
 Strong analytical instincts: comfortable with data, spreadsheets, and spotting trends, and able to turn them into a recommendation. SQL and low-code tools are a plus, and you’re willing to learn them.
 High ownership mindset: you spot problems before they’re assigned and drive them to done.
 Track record of moving fast and finding smarter ways to reach the outcome, and teammates who’d gladly work with you again.
 Organized and process-driven; able to juggle multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Comfortable influencing without authority and working with people at every level.
 If you don’t match every requirement, apply anyway. We care most about how you think and how you deliver.
 What You’ll Get 
 Real ownership. You’ll run projects tied to the company’s top priorities, with your name on the outcome.
 Working time with leaders across the company, and a front-row view of how a growth-stage fintech makes decisions.
 Hands-on AI work. You’ll use it every day and help decide how the whole company uses it.
 A fast path to more scope as you prove yourself.
 Compensation and Benefits 
 Our
